terms.label: 3DModel
terms.comment: A 3D model represents some kind of 3D content, which may have [[encoding]]s in one or more [[MediaObject]]s. Many 3D formats are available (e.g. see [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:3D_graphics_file_formats)); specific encoding formats can be represented using the [[encodingFormat]] property applied to the relevant [[MediaObject]]. For the case of a single file published after Zip compression, the convention of appending '+zip' to the [[encodingFormat]] can be used. Geospatial…

terms.label: AMRadioChannel
terms.comment: A radio channel that uses AM.

terms.label: APIReference
terms.comment: Reference documentation for application programming interfaces (APIs).

terms.label: AboutPage
terms.comment: Web page type: About page.

terms.label: AcceptAction
terms.comment:
The act of committing to/adopting an object.

Related actions:

* [[RejectAction]]: The antonym of AcceptAction.

terms.label: Accommodation
terms.comment:
An accommodation is a place that can accommodate human beings, e.g. a hotel room, a camping pitch, or a meeting room. Many accommodations are for overnight stays, but this is not a mandatory requirement. For more specific types of accommodations not defined in schema.org, one can use [[additionalType]] with external vocabularies.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: AccountingService
terms.comment: Accountancy business.\n\nAs a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

terms.label: AchieveAction
terms.comment: The act of accomplishing something via previous efforts. It is an instantaneous action rather than an ongoing process.

terms.label: Action
terms.comment: An action performed by a direct agent and indirect participants upon a direct object. Optionally happens at a location with the help of an inanimate instrument. The execution of the action may produce a result. Specific action sub-type documentation specifies the exact expectation of each argument/role.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/04/16/announcing-schema-org-actions/) and [Actions overview document](http://schema.org/docs/actions.html).

terms.label: ActionAccessSpecification
terms.comment: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action.

terms.label: ActionStatusType
terms.comment: The status of an Action.

terms.label: ActivateAction
terms.comment: The act of starting or activating a device or application (e.g. starting a timer or turning on a flashlight).

terms.label: AddAction
terms.comment: The act of editing by adding an object to a collection.

terms.label: AdministrativeArea
terms.comment: A geographical region, typically under the jurisdiction of a particular government.

terms.label: AdultEntertainment
terms.comment: An adult entertainment establishment.

terms.label: AdultOrientedEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumeration of considerations that make a product relevant or potentially restricted for adults only.

terms.label: AdvertiserContentArticle
terms.comment: An [[Article]] that an external entity has paid to place or to produce to its specifications. Includes [advertorials](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advertorial), sponsored content, native advertising and other paid content.

terms.label: AggregateOffer
terms.comment: When a single product is associated with multiple offers (for example, the same pair of shoes is offered by different merchants), then AggregateOffer can be used.\n\nNote: AggregateOffers are normally expected to associate multiple offers that all share the same defined [[businessFunction]] value, or default to http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell if businessFunction is not explicitly defined.

terms.label: AggregateRating
terms.comment: The average rating based on multiple ratings or reviews.

terms.label: AgreeAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a consistency of opinion with the object. An agent agrees to/about an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

terms.label: Airline
terms.comment: An organization that provides flights for passengers.

terms.label: Airport
terms.comment: An airport.

terms.label: AlignmentObject
terms.comment: An intangible item that describes an alignment between a learning resource and a node in an educational framework. Should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

terms.label: AllocateAction
terms.comment: The act of organizing tasks/objects/events by associating resources to it.

terms.label: AmpStory
terms.comment: A creative work with a visual storytelling format intended to be viewed online, particularly on mobile devices.

terms.label: AmusementPark
terms.comment: An amusement park.

terms.label: AnalysisNewsArticle
terms.comment: An AnalysisNewsArticle is a [[NewsArticle]] that, while based on factual reporting, incorporates the expertise of the author/producer, offering interpretations and conclusions.

terms.label: AnatomicalStructure
terms.comment: Any part of the human body, typically a component of an anatomical system. Organs, tissues, and cells are all anatomical structures.

terms.label: AnatomicalSystem
terms.comment: An anatomical system is a group of anatomical structures that work together to perform a certain task. Anatomical systems, such as organ systems, are one organizing principle of anatomy, and can include circulatory, digestive, endocrine, integumentary, immune, lymphatic, muscular, nervous, reproductive, respiratory, skeletal, urinary, vestibular, and other systems.

terms.label: AnimalShelter
terms.comment: Animal shelter.

terms.label: Answer
terms.comment: An answer offered to a question; perhaps correct, perhaps opinionated or wrong.

terms.label: Apartment
terms.comment: An apartment (in American English) or flat (in British English) is a self-contained housing unit (a type of residential real estate) that occupies only part of a building (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apartment).

terms.label: ApartmentComplex
terms.comment: Residence type: Apartment complex.

terms.label: AppendAction
terms.comment: The act of inserting at the end if an ordered collection.

terms.label: ApplyAction
terms.comment:
The act of registering to an organization/service without the guarantee to receive it.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, ApplyAction has no guarantees that the application will be accepted.

terms.label: ApprovedIndication
terms.comment: An indication for a medical therapy that has been formally specified or approved by a regulatory body that regulates use of the therapy; for example, the US FDA approves indications for most drugs in the US.

terms.label: Aquarium
terms.comment: Aquarium.

terms.label: ArchiveComponent
terms.comment: An intangible type to be applied to any archive content, carrying with it a set of properties required to describe archival items and collections.

terms.label: ArchiveOrganization
terms.comment: An organization with archival holdings. An organization which keeps and preserves archival material and typically makes it accessible to the public.

terms.label: ArriveAction
terms.comment: The act of arriving at a place. An agent arrives at a destination from a fromLocation, optionally with participants.

terms.label: ArtGallery
terms.comment: An art gallery.

terms.label: Artery
terms.comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood away from the heart.

terms.label: Article
terms.comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

terms.label: AskAction
terms.comment:
The act of posing a question / favor to someone.

Related actions:

* [[ReplyAction]]: Appears generally as a response to AskAction.

terms.label: AskPublicNewsArticle
terms.comment: A [[NewsArticle]] expressing an open call by a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] asking the public for input, insights, clarifications, anecdotes, documentation, etc., on an issue, for reporting purposes.

terms.label: AssessAction
terms.comment: The act of forming one's opinion, reaction or sentiment.

terms.label: AssignAction
terms.comment: The act of allocating an action/event/task to some destination (someone or something).

terms.label: Atlas
terms.comment: A collection or bound volume of maps, charts, plates or tables, physical or in media form illustrating any subject.

terms.label: Attorney
terms.comment: Professional service: Attorney. \n\nThis type is deprecated - [[LegalService]] is more inclusive and less ambiguous.

terms.label: Audience
terms.comment: Intended audience for an item, i.e. the group for whom the item was created.

terms.label: AudioObject
terms.comment: An audio file.

terms.label: AudioObjectSnapshot
terms.comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an [[AudioObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

terms.label: Audiobook
terms.comment: An audiobook.

terms.label: AuthenticateAction
terms.comment: The action of authenticating into a device or application.

terms.label: AuthorizeAction
terms.comment: The act of granting permission to an object.

terms.label: AutoBodyShop
terms.comment: Auto body shop.

terms.label: AutoDealer
terms.comment: An car dealership.

terms.label: AutoPartsStore
terms.comment: An auto parts store.

terms.label: AutoRental
terms.comment: A car rental business.

terms.label: AutoRepair
terms.comment: Car repair business.

terms.label: AutoWash
terms.comment: A car wash business.

terms.label: AutomatedTeller
terms.comment: ATM/cash machine.

terms.label: AutomotiveBusiness
terms.comment: Car repair, sales, or parts.

terms.label: BackgroundNewsArticle
terms.comment: A [[NewsArticle]] providing historical context, definition and detail on a specific topic (aka "explainer" or "backgrounder"). For example, an in-depth article or frequently-asked-questions ([FAQ](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)) document on topics such as Climate Change or the European Union. Other kinds of background material from a non-news setting are often described using [[Book]] or [[Article]], in particular [[ScholarlyArticle]]. See also [[NewsArticle]] for related vocabulary from a …

terms.label: Bakery
terms.comment: A bakery.

terms.label: BankAccount
terms.comment: A product or service offered by a bank whereby one may deposit, withdraw or transfer money and in some cases be paid interest.

terms.label: BankOrCreditUnion
terms.comment: Bank or credit union.

terms.label: BarOrPub
terms.comment: A bar or pub.

terms.label: Barcode
terms.comment: An image of a visual machine-readable code such as a barcode or QR code.

terms.label: Beach
terms.comment: Beach.

terms.label: BeautySalon
terms.comment: Beauty salon.

terms.label: BedAndBreakfast
terms.comment:
Bed and breakfast.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: BedDetails
terms.comment: An entity holding detailed information about the available bed types, e.g. the quantity of twin beds for a hotel room. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you can use bed directly with a text. See also [[BedType]] (under development).

terms.label: BedType
terms.comment: A type of bed. This is used for indicating the bed or beds available in an accommodation.

terms.label: BefriendAction
terms.comment:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone (object) mutually/bidirectionally/symmetrically.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, BefriendAction implies that the connection is reciprocal.

terms.label: BikeStore
terms.comment: A bike store.

terms.label: BioChemEntity
terms.comment: Any biological, chemical, or biochemical thing. For example: a protein; a gene; a chemical; a synthetic chemical.

terms.label: Blog
terms.comment: A [blog](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blog), sometimes known as a "weblog". Note that the individual posts ([[BlogPosting]]s) in a [[Blog]] are often colloquially referred to by the same term.

terms.label: BlogPosting
terms.comment: A blog post.

terms.label: BloodTest
terms.comment: A medical test performed on a sample of a patient's blood.

terms.label: BoardingPolicyType
terms.comment: A type of boarding policy used by an airline.

terms.label: BoatReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for boat travel. Note: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: BoatTerminal
terms.comment: A terminal for boats, ships, and other water vessels.

terms.label: BoatTrip
terms.comment: A trip on a commercial ferry line.

terms.label: BodyMeasurementTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates types (or dimensions) of a person's body measurements, for example for fitting of clothes.

terms.label: BodyOfWater
terms.comment: A body of water, such as a sea, ocean, or lake.

terms.label: Bone
terms.comment: Rigid connective tissue that comprises up the skeletal structure of the human body.

terms.label: Book
terms.comment: A book.

terms.label: BookFormatType
terms.comment: The publication format of the book.

terms.label: BookSeries
terms.comment: A series of books. Included books can be indicated with the hasPart property.

terms.label: BookStore
terms.comment: A bookstore.

terms.label: BookmarkAction
terms.comment: An agent bookmarks/flags/labels/tags/marks an object.

terms.label: Boolean
terms.comment: Boolean: True or False.

terms.label: BorrowAction
terms.comment:
The act of obtaining an object under an agreement to return it at a later date. Reciprocal of LendAction.

Related actions:

* [[LendAction]]: Reciprocal of BorrowAction.

terms.label: BowlingAlley
terms.comment: A bowling alley.

terms.label: BrainStructure
terms.comment: Any anatomical structure which pertains to the soft nervous tissue functioning as the coordinating center of sensation and intellectual and nervous activity.

terms.label: Brand
terms.comment: A brand is a name used by an organization or business person for labeling a product, product group, or similar.

terms.label: BreadcrumbList
terms.comment: A BreadcrumbList is an ItemList consisting of a chain of linked Web pages, typically described using at least their URL and their name, and typically ending with the current page.\n\nThe [[position]] property is used to reconstruct the order of the items in a BreadcrumbList. The convention is that a breadcrumb list has an [[itemListOrder]] of [[ItemListOrderAscending]] (lower values listed first), and that the first items in this list correspond to the "top" or beginning of the breadcrumb trail…

terms.label: Brewery
terms.comment: Brewery.

terms.label: Bridge
terms.comment: A bridge.

terms.label: BroadcastChannel
terms.comment: A unique instance of a BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

terms.label: BroadcastEvent
terms.comment: An over the air or online broadcast event.

terms.label: BroadcastFrequencySpecification
terms.comment: The frequency in MHz and the modulation used for a particular BroadcastService.

terms.label: BroadcastService
terms.comment: A delivery service through which content is provided via broadcast over the air or online.

terms.label: BrokerageAccount
terms.comment: An account that allows an investor to deposit funds and place investment orders with a licensed broker or brokerage firm.

terms.label: BuddhistTemple
terms.comment: A Buddhist temple.

terms.label: BusOrCoach
terms.comment: A bus (also omnibus or autobus) is a road vehicle designed to carry passengers. Coaches are luxury buses, usually in service for long distance travel.

terms.label: BusReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for bus travel. \n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: BusStation
terms.comment: A bus station.

terms.label: BusStop
terms.comment: A bus stop.

terms.label: BusTrip
terms.comment: A trip on a commercial bus line.

terms.label: BusinessAudience
terms.comment: A set of characteristics belonging to businesses, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

terms.label: BusinessEntityType
terms.comment:
A business entity type is a conceptual entity representing the legal form, the size, the main line of business, the position in the value chain, or any combination thereof, of an organization or business person.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Business
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Enduser
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PublicInstitution
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Reseller

terms.label: BusinessEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Business event.

terms.label: BusinessFunction
terms.comment:
The business function specifies the type of activity or access (i.e., the bundle of rights) offered by the organization or business person through the offer. Typical are sell, rental or lease, maintenance or repair, manufacture / produce, recycle / dispose, engineering / construction, or installation. Proprietary specifications of access rights are also instances of this class.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ConstructionInstallation
* http://purl.org/goodrelatio…

terms.label: BuyAction
terms.comment: The act of giving money to a seller in exchange for goods or services rendered. An agent buys an object, product, or service from a seller for a price. Reciprocal of SellAction.

terms.label: CDCPMDRecord
terms.comment: A CDCPMDRecord is a data structure representing a record in a CDC tabular data format used for hospital data reporting. See [documentation](/docs/cdc-covid.html) for details, and the linked CDC materials for authoritative definitions used as the source here.

terms.label: CableOrSatelliteService
terms.comment: A service which provides access to media programming like TV or radio. Access may be via cable or satellite.

terms.label: CafeOrCoffeeShop
terms.comment: A cafe or coffee shop.

terms.label: Campground
terms.comment: A camping site, campsite, or [[Campground]] is a place used for overnight stay in the outdoors, typically containing individual [[CampingPitch]] locations. \n\n In British English a campsite is an area, usually divided into a number of pitches, where people can camp overnight using tents or camper vans or caravans; this British English use of the word is synonymous with the American English expression campground. In American English the term campsite generally means an area where an individual,…

terms.label: CampingPitch
terms.comment: A [[CampingPitch]] is an individual place for overnight stay in the outdoors, typically being part of a larger camping site, or [[Campground]].\n\n In British English a campsite, or campground, is an area, usually divided into a number of pitches, where people can camp overnight using tents or camper vans or caravans; this British English use of the word is synonymous with the American English expression campground. In American English the term campsite generally means an area where an individu…

terms.label: Canal
terms.comment: A canal, like the Panama Canal.

terms.label: CancelAction
terms.comment:
The act of asserting that a future event/action is no longer going to happen.

Related actions:

* [[ConfirmAction]]: The antonym of CancelAction.

terms.label: Car
terms.comment: A car is a wheeled, self-powered motor vehicle used for transportation.

terms.label: CarUsageType
terms.comment: A value indicating a special usage of a car, e.g. commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi.

terms.label: Casino
terms.comment: A casino.

terms.label: CategoryCode
terms.comment: A Category Code.

terms.label: CategoryCodeSet
terms.comment: A set of Category Code values.

terms.label: CatholicChurch
terms.comment: A Catholic church.

terms.label: Cemetery
terms.comment: A graveyard.

terms.label: Certification
terms.comment: A Certification is an official and authoritative statement about a subject, for example a product, service, person, or organization. A certification is typically issued by an indendent certification body, for example a professional organization or government. It formally attests certain characteristics about the subject, for example Organizations can be ISO certified, Food products can be certified Organic or Vegan, a Person can be a certified professional, a Place can be certified for food pro…

terms.label: CertificationStatusEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates the different statuses of a Certification (Active and Inactive).

terms.label: Chapter
terms.comment: One of the sections into which a book is divided. A chapter usually has a section number or a name.

terms.label: CheckAction
terms.comment: An agent inspects, determines, investigates, inquires, or examines an object's accuracy, quality, condition, or state.

terms.label: CheckInAction
terms.comment:
The act of an agent communicating (service provider, social media, etc) their arrival by registering/confirming for a previously reserved service (e.g. flight check-in) or at a place (e.g. hotel), possibly resulting in a result (boarding pass, etc).

Related actions:

* [[CheckOutAction]]: The antonym of CheckInAction.
* [[ArriveAction]]: Unlike ArriveAction, CheckInAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the start of a previously reserved service.
* [[ConfirmAction]]: Unlik…

terms.label: CheckOutAction
terms.comment:
The act of an agent communicating (service provider, social media, etc) their departure of a previously reserved service (e.g. flight check-in) or place (e.g. hotel).

Related actions:

* [[CheckInAction]]: The antonym of CheckOutAction.
* [[DepartAction]]: Unlike DepartAction, CheckOutAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the end of a previously reserved service.
* [[CancelAction]]: Unlike CancelAction, CheckOutAction implies that the agent is informing/confirming the end…

terms.label: CheckoutPage
terms.comment: Web page type: Checkout page.

terms.label: ChemicalSubstance
terms.comment: A chemical substance is 'a portion of matter of constant composition, composed of molecular entities of the same type or of different types' (source: [ChEBI:59999](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/searchId.do?chebiId=59999)).

terms.label: ChildCare
terms.comment: A Childcare center.

terms.label: ChildrensEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Children's event.

terms.label: ChooseAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a preference from a set of options or a large or unbounded set of choices/options.

terms.label: Church
terms.comment: A church.

terms.label: City
terms.comment: A city or town.

terms.label: CityHall
terms.comment: A city hall.

terms.label: CivicStructure
terms.comment: A public structure, such as a town hall or concert hall.

terms.label: Claim
terms.comment: A [[Claim]] in Schema.org represents a specific, factually-oriented claim that could be the [[itemReviewed]] in a [[ClaimReview]]. The content of a claim can be summarized with the [[text]] property. Variations on well known claims can have their common identity indicated via [[sameAs]] links, and summarized with a [[name]]. Ideally, a [[Claim]] description includes enough contextual information to minimize the risk of ambiguity or inclarity. In practice, many claims are better understood in th…

terms.label: ClaimReview
terms.comment: A fact-checking review of claims made (or reported) in some creative work (referenced via itemReviewed).

terms.label: Class
terms.comment: A class, also often called a 'Type'; equivalent to rdfs:Class.

terms.label: Clip
terms.comment: A short TV or radio program or a segment/part of a program.

terms.label: ClothingStore
terms.comment: A clothing store.

terms.label: Code
terms.comment: Computer programming source code. Example: Full (compile ready) solutions, code snippet samples, scripts, templates.

terms.label: Collection
terms.comment: A collection of items, e.g. creative works or products.

terms.label: CollectionPage
terms.comment: Web page type: Collection page.

terms.label: CollegeOrUniversity
terms.comment: A college, university, or other third-level educational institution.

terms.label: ComedyClub
terms.comment: A comedy club.

terms.label: ComedyEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Comedy event.

terms.label: ComicCoverArt
terms.comment: The artwork on the cover of a comic.

terms.label: ComicIssue
terms.comment: Individual comic issues are serially published as part of a larger series. For the sake of consistency, even one-shot issues belong to a series comprised of a single issue. All comic issues can be uniquely identified by: the combination of the name and volume number of the series to which the issue belongs; the issue number; and the variant description of the issue (if any).

terms.label: ComicSeries
terms.comment: A sequential publication of comic stories under a unifying title, for example "The Amazing Spider-Man" or "Groo the Wanderer".

terms.label: ComicStory
terms.comment: The term "story" is any indivisible, re-printable unit of a comic, including the interior stories, covers, and backmatter. Most comics have at least two stories: a cover (ComicCoverArt) and an interior story.

terms.label: Comment
terms.comment: A comment on an item - for example, a comment on a blog post. The comment's content is expressed via the [[text]] property, and its topic via [[about]], properties shared with all CreativeWorks.

terms.label: CommentAction
terms.comment: The act of generating a comment about a subject.

terms.label: CommunicateAction
terms.comment: The act of conveying information to another person via a communication medium (instrument) such as speech, email, or telephone conversation.

terms.label: CompleteDataFeed
terms.comment: A [[CompleteDataFeed]] is a [[DataFeed]] whose standard representation includes content for every item currently in the feed. This is the equivalent of Atom's element as defined in Feed Paging and Archiving [RFC 5005](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5005), for example (and as defined for Atom), when using data from a feed that represents a collection of items that varies over time (e.g. "Top Twenty Records") there is no need to have newer entries mixed in alongside older, obsolete entries. By ma…

terms.label: CompoundPriceSpecification
terms.comment: A compound price specification is one that bundles multiple prices that all apply in combination for different dimensions of consumption. Use the name property of the attached unit price specification for indicating the dimension of a price component (e.g. "electricity" or "final cleaning").

terms.label: ComputerLanguage
terms.comment: This type covers computer programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, as well as other language-like computer representations. Natural languages are best represented with the [[Language]] type.

terms.label: ComputerStore
terms.comment: A computer store.

terms.label: ConferenceEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Conference event.

terms.label: ConfirmAction
terms.comment:
The act of notifying someone that a future event/action is going to happen as expected.

Related actions:

* [[CancelAction]]: The antonym of ConfirmAction.

terms.label: Consortium
terms.comment: A Consortium is a membership [[Organization]] whose members are typically Organizations.

terms.label: ConstraintNode
terms.comment: The ConstraintNode type is provided to support usecases in which a node in a structured data graph is described with properties which appear to describe a single entity, but are being used in a situation where they serve a more abstract purpose. A [[ConstraintNode]] can be described using [[constraintProperty]] and [[numConstraints]]. These constraint properties can serve a variety of purposes, and their values may sometimes be understood to indicate sets of possible values rather than single, …

terms.label: ConsumeAction
terms.comment: The act of ingesting information/resources/food.

terms.label: ContactPage
terms.comment: Web page type: Contact page.

terms.label: ContactPoint
terms.comment: A contact point—for example, a Customer Complaints department.

terms.label: ContactPointOption
terms.comment: Enumerated options related to a ContactPoint.

terms.label: Continent
terms.comment: One of the continents (for example, Europe or Africa).

terms.label: ControlAction
terms.comment: An agent controls a device or application.

terms.label: ConvenienceStore
terms.comment: A convenience store.

terms.label: Conversation
terms.comment: One or more messages between organizations or people on a particular topic. Individual messages can be linked to the conversation with isPartOf or hasPart properties.

terms.label: CookAction
terms.comment: The act of producing/preparing food.

terms.label: Cooperative
terms.comment: An organization that is a joint project of multiple organizations or persons.

terms.label: Corporation
terms.comment: Organization: A business corporation.

terms.label: CorrectionComment
terms.comment: A [[comment]] that corrects [[CreativeWork]].

terms.label: Country
terms.comment: A country.

terms.label: Course
terms.comment: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or more educational events and/or creative works which aims to build knowledge, competence or ability of learners.

terms.label: CourseInstance
terms.comment: An instance of a [[Course]] which is distinct from other instances because it is offered at a different time or location or through different media or modes of study or to a specific section of students.

terms.label: Courthouse
terms.comment: A courthouse.

terms.label: CoverArt
terms.comment: The artwork on the outer surface of a CreativeWork.

terms.label: CovidTestingFacility
terms.comment: A CovidTestingFacility is a [[MedicalClinic]] where testing for the COVID-19 Coronavirus disease is available. If the facility is being made available from an established [[Pharmacy]], [[Hotel]], or other non-medical organization, multiple types can be listed. This makes it easier to re-use existing schema.org information about that place, e.g. contact info, address, opening hours. Note that in an emergency, such information may not always be reliable.

terms.label: CreateAction
terms.comment: The act of deliberately creating/producing/generating/building a result out of the agent.

terms.label: CreativeWork
terms.comment: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.

terms.label: CreativeWorkSeason
terms.comment: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

terms.label: CreativeWorkSeries
terms.comment: A CreativeWorkSeries in schema.org is a group of related items, typically but not necessarily of the same kind. CreativeWorkSeries are usually organized into some order, often chronological. Unlike [[ItemList]] which is a general purpose data structure for lists of things, the emphasis with CreativeWorkSeries is on published materials (written e.g. books and periodicals, or media such as TV, radio and games).\n\nSpecific subtypes are available for describing [[TVSeries]], [[RadioSeries]], [[Mov…

terms.label: Credential
terms.comment: A credential is a certificate that is used to verify the identity of a person or entity.

terms.label: CreditCard
terms.comment:
A card payment method of a particular brand or name. Used to mark up a particular payment method and/or the financial product/service that supplies the card account.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#AmericanExpress
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DinersClub
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Discover
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#JCB
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#MasterCard
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#VISA

terms.label: Crematorium
terms.comment: A crematorium.

terms.label: CriticReview
terms.comment: A [[CriticReview]] is a more specialized form of Review written or published by a source that is recognized for its reviewing activities. These can include online columns, travel and food guides, TV and radio shows, blogs and other independent Web sites. [[CriticReview]]s are typically more in-depth and professionally written. For simpler, casually written user/visitor/viewer/customer reviews, it is more appropriate to use the [[UserReview]] type. Review aggregator sites such as Metacritic alre…

terms.label: CssSelectorType
terms.comment: Text representing a CSS selector.

terms.label: CurrencyConversionService
terms.comment: A service to convert funds from one currency to another currency.

terms.label: DDxElement
terms.comment: An alternative, closely-related condition typically considered later in the differential diagnosis process along with the signs that are used to distinguish it.

terms.label: DENonprofitType
terms.comment: DENonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Germany in accordance with article 52 of the German fiscal code (Abgabenverordnung or AO).

terms.label: DanceEvent
terms.comment: Event type: A social dance.

terms.label: DanceGroup
terms.comment: A dance group—for example, the Alvin Ailey Dance Theater or Riverdance.

terms.label: DataCatalog
terms.comment: A collection of datasets.

terms.label: DataDownload
terms.comment: All or part of a [[Dataset]] in downloadable form.

terms.label: DataFeed
terms.comment: A single feed providing structured information about one or more entities or topics.

terms.label: DataFeedItem
terms.comment: A single item within a larger data feed.

terms.label: DataType
terms.comment: The basic data types such as Integers, Strings, etc.

terms.label: Dataset
terms.comment: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

terms.label: Date
terms.comment: A date value in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

terms.label: DateTime
terms.comment: A combination of date and time of day in the form [-]CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see Chapter 5.4 of ISO 8601).

terms.label: DatedMoneySpecification
terms.comment: A DatedMoneySpecification represents monetary values with optional start and end dates. For example, this could represent an employee's salary over a specific period of time. __Note:__ This type has been superseded by [[MonetaryAmount]], use of that type is recommended.

terms.label: DayOfWeek
terms.comment: The day of the week, e.g. used to specify to which day the opening hours of an OpeningHoursSpecification refer. Originally, URLs from [GoodRelations](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1) were used (for [[Monday]], [[Tuesday]], [[Wednesday]], [[Thursday]], [[Friday]], [[Saturday]], [[Sunday]] plus a special entry for [[PublicHolidays]]); these have now been integrated directly into schema.org.

terms.label: DaySpa
terms.comment: A day spa.

terms.label: DeactivateAction
terms.comment: The act of stopping or deactivating a device or application (e.g. stopping a timer or turning off a flashlight).

terms.label: DeclarationOfConformity
terms.comment: A Declaration of Conformity (DoC), a formal document issued by a manufacturer declaring that a product meets specific regulatory requirements.

terms.label: DefenceEstablishment
terms.comment: A defence establishment, such as an army or navy base.

terms.label: DefinedRegion
terms.comment: A DefinedRegion is a geographic area defined by potentially arbitrary (rather than political, administrative or natural geographical) criteria. Properties are provided for defining a region by reference to sets of postal codes. Examples: a delivery destination when shopping. Region where regional pricing is configured. Requirement 1: Country: US States: "NY", "CA" Requirement 2: Country: US PostalCode Set: { [94000-94585], [97000, 97999], [13000, 13599]} { [12345, 12345], [78945, 78945], } Regi…

terms.label: DefinedTerm
terms.comment: A word, name, acronym, phrase, etc. with a formal definition. Often used in the context of category or subject classification, glossaries or dictionaries, product or creative work types, etc. Use the name property for the term being defined, use termCode if the term has an alpha-numeric code allocated, use description to provide the definition of the term. Use the about property to specify what the term is about.

terms.label: DefinedTermSet
terms.comment: A set of defined terms, for example a set of categories or a classification scheme, a glossary, dictionary or enumeration. Use the about property to specify what the term set is about.

terms.label: DeleteAction
terms.comment: The act of editing a recipient by removing one of its objects.

terms.label: DeliveryChargeSpecification
terms.comment: The price for the delivery of an offer using a particular delivery method.

terms.label: DeliveryEvent
terms.comment: An event involving the delivery of an item.

terms.label: DeliveryMethod
terms.comment:
A delivery method is a standardized procedure for transferring the product or service to the destination of fulfillment chosen by the customer. Delivery methods are characterized by the means of transportation used, and by the organization or group that is the contracting party for the sending organization or person.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModeDirectDownload
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DeliveryModeFreight
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v…

terms.label: DeliveryTimeSettings
terms.comment: A DeliveryTimeSettings represents re-usable pieces of shipping information, relating to timing. It is designed for publication on an URL that may be referenced via the [[shippingSettingsLink]] property of an [[OfferShippingDetails]]. Several occurrences can be published, distinguished (and identified/referenced) by their different values for [[transitTimeLabel]].

terms.label: Demand
terms.comment: A demand entity represents the public, not necessarily binding, not necessarily exclusive, announcement by an organization or person to seek a certain type of goods or services. For describing demand using this type, the very same properties used for Offer apply.

terms.label: Dentist
terms.comment: A dentist.

terms.label: DepartAction
terms.comment: The act of departing from a place. An agent departs from a fromLocation for a destination, optionally with participants.

terms.label: DepartmentStore
terms.comment: A department store.

terms.label: DepositAccount
terms.comment: A type of Bank Account with a main purpose of depositing funds to gain interest or other benefits.

terms.label: DiagnosticLab
terms.comment: A medical laboratory that offers on-site or off-site diagnostic services.

terms.label: DiagnosticProcedure
terms.comment: A medical procedure intended primarily for diagnostic, as opposed to therapeutic, purposes.

terms.label: Diet
terms.comment: A strategy of regulating the intake of food to achieve or maintain a specific health-related goal.

terms.label: DietarySupplement
terms.comment: A product taken by mouth that contains a dietary ingredient intended to supplement the diet. Dietary ingredients may include vitamins, minerals, herbs or other botanicals, amino acids, and substances such as enzymes, organ tissues, glandulars and metabolites.

terms.label: DigitalDocument
terms.comment: An electronic file or document.

terms.label: DigitalDocumentPermission
terms.comment: A permission for a particular person or group to access a particular file.

terms.label: DigitalDocumentPermissionType
terms.comment: A type of permission which can be granted for accessing a digital document.

terms.label: DigitalPlatformEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates some common technology platforms, for use with properties such as [[actionPlatform]]. It is not supposed to be comprehensive - when a suitable code is not enumerated here, textual or URL values can be used instead. These codes are at a fairly high level and do not deal with versioning and other nuance. Additional codes can be suggested [in github](https://github.com/schemaorg/schemaorg/issues/3057).

terms.label: DigitalProductPassport
terms.comment: A digital product passport (DPP), a record containing information about a product's lifecycle, sustainability, and compliance.

terms.label: DisagreeAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a difference of opinion with the object. An agent disagrees to/about an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

terms.label: DiscoverAction
terms.comment: The act of discovering/finding an object.

terms.label: DiscussionForumPosting
terms.comment: A posting to a discussion forum.

terms.label: DislikeAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a negative sentiment about the object. An agent dislikes an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

terms.label: Distance
terms.comment: Properties that take Distances as values are of the form '<Number> <Length unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 ft'.

terms.label: Distillery
terms.comment: A distillery.

terms.label: DonateAction
terms.comment: The act of providing goods, services, or money without compensation, often for philanthropic reasons.

terms.label: DoseSchedule
terms.comment: A specific dosing schedule for a drug or supplement.

terms.label: DownloadAction
terms.comment: The act of downloading an object.

terms.label: DrawAction
terms.comment: The act of producing a visual/graphical representation of an object, typically with a pen/pencil and paper as instruments.

terms.label: Drawing
terms.comment: A picture or diagram made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

terms.label: DrinkAction
terms.comment: The act of swallowing liquids.

terms.label: DriveWheelConfigurationValue
terms.comment: A value indicating which roadwheels will receive torque.

terms.label: Drug
terms.comment: A chemical or biologic substance, used as a medical therapy, that has a physiological effect on an organism. Here the term drug is used interchangeably with the term medicine although clinical knowledge makes a clear difference between them.

terms.label: DrugClass
terms.comment: A class of medical drugs, e.g., statins. Classes can represent general pharmacological class, common mechanisms of action, common physiological effects, etc.

terms.label: DrugCost
terms.comment: The cost per unit of a medical drug. Note that this type is not meant to represent the price in an offer of a drug for sale; see the Offer type for that. This type will typically be used to tag wholesale or average retail cost of a drug, or maximum reimbursable cost. Costs of medical drugs vary widely depending on how and where they are paid for, so while this type captures some of the variables, costs should be used with caution by consumers of this schema's markup.

terms.label: DrugCostCategory
terms.comment: Enumerated categories of medical drug costs.

terms.label: DrugLegalStatus
terms.comment: The legal availability status of a medical drug.

terms.label: DrugPregnancyCategory
terms.comment: Categories that represent an assessment of the risk of fetal injury due to a drug or pharmaceutical used as directed by the mother during pregnancy.

terms.label: DrugPrescriptionStatus
terms.comment: Indicates whether this drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter.

terms.label: DrugStrength
terms.comment: A specific strength in which a medical drug is available in a specific country.

terms.label: DryCleaningOrLaundry
terms.comment: A dry-cleaning business.

terms.label: Duration
terms.comment: Quantity: Duration (use [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

terms.label: EUEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates the EU energy efficiency classes A-G as well as A+, A++, and A+++ as defined in EU directive 2017/1369.

terms.label: EatAction
terms.comment: The act of swallowing solid objects.

terms.label: EducationEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Education event.

terms.label: EducationalAudience
terms.comment: An EducationalAudience.

terms.label: EducationalOccupationalCredential
terms.comment: An educational or occupational credential. A diploma, academic degree, certification, qualification, badge, etc., that may be awarded to a person or other entity that meets the requirements defined by the credentialer.

terms.label: EducationalOccupationalProgram
terms.comment: A program offered by an institution which determines the learning progress to achieve an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate. This would define a discrete set of opportunities (e.g., job, courses) that together constitute a program with a clear start, end, set of requirements, and transition to a new occupational opportunity (e.g., a job), or sometimes a higher educational opportunity (e.g., an advanced degree).

terms.label: EducationalOrganization
terms.comment: An educational organization.

terms.label: Electrician
terms.comment: An electrician.

terms.label: ElectronicsStore
terms.comment: An electronics store.

terms.label: ElementarySchool
terms.comment: An elementary school.

terms.label: EmailMessage
terms.comment: An email message.

terms.label: Embassy
terms.comment: An embassy.

terms.label: EmergencyService
terms.comment: An emergency service, such as a fire station or ER.

terms.label: EmployeeRole
terms.comment: A subclass of OrganizationRole used to describe employee relationships.

terms.label: EmployerAggregateRating
terms.comment: An aggregate rating of an Organization related to its role as an employer.

terms.label: EmployerReview
terms.comment: An [[EmployerReview]] is a review of an [[Organization]] regarding its role as an employer, written by a current or former employee of that organization.

terms.label: EmploymentAgency
terms.comment: An employment agency.

terms.label: EndorseAction
terms.comment: An agent approves/certifies/likes/supports/sanctions an object.

terms.label: EndorsementRating
terms.comment: An EndorsementRating is a rating that expresses some level of endorsement, for example inclusion in a "critic's pick" blog, a "Like" or "+1" on a social network. It can be considered the [[result]] of an [[EndorseAction]] in which the [[object]] of the action is rated positively by some [[agent]]. As is common elsewhere in schema.org, it is sometimes more useful to describe the results of such an action without explicitly describing the [[Action]]. An [[EndorsementRating]] may be part of a nume…

terms.label: Energy
terms.comment: Properties that take Energy as values are of the form '<Number> <Energy unit of measure>'.

terms.label: EnergyConsumptionDetails
terms.comment: EnergyConsumptionDetails represents information related to the energy efficiency of a product that consumes energy. The information that can be provided is based on international regulations such as for example [EU directive 2017/1369](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/1369/oj) for energy labeling and the [Energy labeling rule](https://www.ftc.gov/enforcement/rules/rulemaking-regulatory-reform-proceedings/energy-water-use-labeling-consumer) under the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (EPC…

terms.label: EnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates energy efficiency levels (also known as "classes" or "ratings") and certifications that are part of several international energy efficiency standards.

terms.label: EnergyStarEnergyEfficiencyEnumeration
terms.comment: Used to indicate whether a product is EnergyStar certified.

terms.label: EngineSpecification
terms.comment: Information about the engine of the vehicle. A vehicle can have multiple engines represented by multiple engine specification entities.

terms.label: EntertainmentBusiness
terms.comment: A business providing entertainment.

terms.label: EntryPoint
terms.comment: An entry point, within some Web-based protocol.

terms.label: Enumeration
terms.comment: Lists or enumerations—for example, a list of cuisines or music genres, etc.

terms.label: EnvironmentalProductDeclaration
terms.comment: An Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) that quantifies environmental information on the life cycle of a product.

terms.label: Episode
terms.comment: A media episode (e.g. TV, radio, video game) which can be part of a series or season.

terms.label: Error
terms.comment: Representation of an Error.

terms.label: Event
terms.comment: An event happening at a certain time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Ticketing information may be added via the [[offers]] property. Repeated events may be structured as separate Event objects.

terms.label: EventAttendanceModeEnumeration
terms.comment: An EventAttendanceModeEnumeration value is one of potentially several modes of organising an event, relating to whether it is online or offline.

terms.label: EventReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for an event like a concert, sporting event, or lecture.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: EventSeries
terms.comment: A series of [[Event]]s. Included events can relate with the series using the [[superEvent]] property. An EventSeries is a collection of events that share some unifying characteristic. For example, "The Olympic Games" is a series, which is repeated regularly. The "2012 London Olympics" can be presented both as an [[Event]] in the series "Olympic Games", and as an [[EventSeries]] that included a number of sporting competitions as Events. The nature of the association between the events in an [[Ev…

terms.label: EventStatusType
terms.comment: EventStatusType is an enumeration type whose instances represent several states that an Event may be in.

terms.label: EventVenue
terms.comment: An event venue.

terms.label: ExchangeRateSpecification
terms.comment: A structured value representing exchange rate.

terms.label: ExerciseAction
terms.comment: The act of participating in exertive activity for the purposes of improving health and fitness.

terms.label: ExerciseGym
terms.comment: A gym.

terms.label: ExercisePlan
terms.comment: Fitness-related activity designed for a specific health-related purpose, including defined exercise routines as well as activity prescribed by a clinician.

terms.label: ExhibitionEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Exhibition event, e.g. at a museum, library, archive, tradeshow, ...

terms.label: FAQPage
terms.comment: A [[FAQPage]] is a [[WebPage]] presenting one or more "[Frequently asked questions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)" (see also [[QAPage]]).

terms.label: FMRadioChannel
terms.comment: A radio channel that uses FM.

terms.label: FastFoodRestaurant
terms.comment: A fast-food restaurant.

terms.label: Festival
terms.comment: Event type: Festival.

terms.label: FilmAction
terms.comment: The act of capturing sound and moving images on film, video, or digitally.

terms.label: FinancialIncentive
terms.comment:
Represents financial incentives for goods/services offered by an organization (or individual).

Typically contains the [[name]] of the incentive, the [[incentivizedItem]], the [[incentiveAmount]], the [[incentiveStatus]], [[incentiveType]], the [[provider]] of the incentive, and [[eligibleWithSupplier]].

Optionally contains criteria on whether the incentive is limited based on [[purchaseType]], [[purchasePriceLimit]], [[incomeLimit]], and the [[qualifiedExpense]].

terms.label: FinancialProduct
terms.comment: A product provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies which comprise the financial services industry.

terms.label: FinancialService
terms.comment: Financial services business.

terms.label: FindAction
terms.comment:
The act of finding an object.

Related actions:

* [[SearchAction]]: FindAction is generally lead by a SearchAction, but not necessarily.

terms.label: FireStation
terms.comment: A fire station. With firemen.

terms.label: Flight
terms.comment: An airline flight.

terms.label: FlightReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for air travel.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: Float
terms.comment: Data type: Floating number.

terms.label: FloorPlan
terms.comment: A FloorPlan is an explicit representation of a collection of similar accommodations, allowing the provision of common information (room counts, sizes, layout diagrams) and offers for rental or sale. In typical use, some [[ApartmentComplex]] has an [[accommodationFloorPlan]] which is a [[FloorPlan]]. A FloorPlan is always in the context of a particular place, either a larger [[ApartmentComplex]] or a single [[Apartment]]. The visual/spatial aspects of a floor plan (i.e. room layout, [see wikiped…

terms.label: Florist
terms.comment: A florist.

terms.label: FollowAction
terms.comment:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone/something (object) unidirectionally/asymmetrically to get updates polled from.

Related actions:

* [[BefriendAction]]: Unlike BefriendAction, FollowAction implies that the connection is *not* necessarily reciprocal.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, FollowAction implies that the follower acts as an active agent constantly/actively polling for updates.
* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, FollowAction implies that …

terms.label: FoodEstablishment
terms.comment: A food-related business.

terms.label: FoodEstablishmentReservation
terms.comment: A reservation to dine at a food-related business.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

terms.label: FoodEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Food event.

terms.label: FoodService
terms.comment: A food service, like breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

terms.label: FulfillmentTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: A type of product fulfillment.

terms.label: FundingAgency
terms.comment: A FundingAgency is an organization that implements one or more [[FundingScheme]]s and manages the granting process (via [[Grant]]s, typically [[MonetaryGrant]]s). A funding agency is not always required for grant funding, e.g. philanthropic giving, corporate sponsorship etc. Examples of funding agencies include ERC, REA, NIH, Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, ...

terms.label: FundingScheme
terms.comment: A FundingScheme combines organizational, project and policy aspects of grant-based funding that sets guidelines, principles and mechanisms to support other kinds of projects and activities. Funding is typically organized via [[Grant]] funding. Examples of funding schemes: Swiss Priority Programmes (SPPs); EU Framework 7 (FP7); Horizon 2020; the NIH-R01 Grant Program; Wellcome institutional strategic support fund. For large scale public sector funding, the management and administration of grant …

terms.label: FurnitureStore
terms.comment: A furniture store.

terms.label: Game
terms.comment: The Game type represents things which are games. These are typically rule-governed recreational activities, e.g. role-playing games in which players assume the role of characters in a fictional setting.

terms.label: GameAvailabilityEnumeration
terms.comment: For a [[VideoGame]], such as used with a [[PlayGameAction]], an enumeration of the kind of game availability offered.

terms.label: GamePlayMode
terms.comment: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player.

terms.label: GameServer
terms.comment: Server that provides game interaction in a multiplayer game.

terms.label: GameServerStatus
terms.comment: Status of a game server.

terms.label: GardenStore
terms.comment: A garden store.

terms.label: GasStation
terms.comment: A gas station.

terms.label: GatedResidenceCommunity
terms.comment: Residence type: Gated community.

terms.label: GenderType
terms.comment: An enumeration of genders.

terms.label: Gene
terms.comment: A discrete unit of inheritance which affects one or more biological traits (Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene)). Examples include FOXP2 (Forkhead box protein P2), SCARNA21 (small Cajal body-specific RNA 21), A- (agouti genotype).

terms.label: GeneralContractor
terms.comment: A general contractor.

terms.label: GeoCircle
terms.comment: A GeoCircle is a GeoShape representing a circular geographic area. As it is a GeoShape it provides the simple textual property 'circle', but also allows the combination of postalCode alongside geoRadius. The center of the circle can be indicated via the 'geoMidpoint' property, or more approximately using 'address', 'postalCode'.

terms.label: GeoCoordinates
terms.comment: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

terms.label: GeoShape
terms.comment: The geographic shape of a place. A GeoShape can be described using several properties whose values are based on latitude/longitude pairs. Either whitespace or commas can be used to separate latitude and longitude; whitespace should be used when writing a list of several such points.

terms.label: GeospatialGeometry
terms.comment: (Eventually to be defined as) a supertype of GeoShape designed to accommodate definitions from Geo-Spatial best practices.

terms.label: GiveAction
terms.comment:
The act of transferring ownership of an object to a destination. Reciprocal of TakeAction.

Related actions:

* [[TakeAction]]: Reciprocal of GiveAction.
* [[SendAction]]: Unlike SendAction, GiveAction implies that ownership is being transferred (e.g. I may send my laptop to you, but that doesn't mean I'm giving it to you).

terms.label: GolfCourse
terms.comment: A golf course.

terms.label: GovernmentBenefitsType
terms.comment: GovernmentBenefitsType enumerates several kinds of government benefits to support the COVID-19 situation. Note that this structure may not capture all benefits offered.

terms.label: GovernmentBuilding
terms.comment: A government building.

terms.label: GovernmentOffice
terms.comment: A government office—for example, an IRS or DMV office.

terms.label: GovernmentOrganization
terms.comment: A governmental organization or agency.

terms.label: GovernmentPermit
terms.comment: A permit issued by a government agency.

terms.label: GovernmentService
terms.comment: A service provided by a government organization, e.g. food stamps, veterans benefits, etc.

terms.label: Grant
terms.comment: A grant, typically financial or otherwise quantifiable, of resources. Typically a [[funder]] sponsors some [[MonetaryAmount]] to an [[Organization]] or [[Person]], sometimes not necessarily via a dedicated or long-lived [[Project]], resulting in one or more outputs, or [[fundedItem]]s. For financial sponsorship, indicate the [[funder]] of a [[MonetaryGrant]]. For non-financial support, indicate [[sponsor]] of [[Grant]]s of resources (e.g. office space). Grants support activities directed toward…

terms.label: GroceryStore
terms.comment: A grocery store.

terms.label: Guide
terms.comment: [[Guide]] is a page or article that recommends specific products or services, or aspects of a thing for a user to consider. A [[Guide]] may represent a Buying Guide and detail aspects of products or services for a user to consider. A [[Guide]] may represent a Product Guide and recommend specific products or services. A [[Guide]] may represent a Ranked List and recommend specific products or services with ranking.

terms.label: HVACBusiness
terms.comment: A business that provides Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning services.

terms.label: Hackathon
terms.comment: A [hackathon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hackathon) event.

terms.label: HairSalon
terms.comment: A hair salon.

terms.label: HardwareStore
terms.comment: A hardware store.

terms.label: HealthAndBeautyBusiness
terms.comment: Health and beauty.

terms.label: HealthAspectEnumeration
terms.comment: HealthAspectEnumeration enumerates several aspects of health content online, each of which might be described using [[hasHealthAspect]] and [[HealthTopicContent]].

terms.label: HealthClub
terms.comment: A health club.

terms.label: HealthInsurancePlan
terms.comment: A US-style health insurance plan, including PPOs, EPOs, and HMOs.

terms.label: HealthPlanCostSharingSpecification
terms.comment: A description of costs to the patient under a given network or formulary.

terms.label: HealthPlanFormulary
terms.comment: For a given health insurance plan, the specification for costs and coverage of prescription drugs.

terms.label: HealthPlanNetwork
terms.comment: A US-style health insurance plan network.

terms.label: HealthTopicContent
terms.comment: [[HealthTopicContent]] is [[WebContent]] that is about some aspect of a health topic, e.g. a condition, its symptoms or treatments. Such content may be comprised of several parts or sections and use different types of media. Multiple instances of [[WebContent]] (and hence [[HealthTopicContent]]) can be related using [[hasPart]] / [[isPartOf]] where there is some kind of content hierarchy, and their content described with [[about]] and [[mentions]] e.g. building upon the existing [[MedicalCondit…

terms.label: HighSchool
terms.comment: A high school.

terms.label: HinduTemple
terms.comment: A Hindu temple.

terms.label: HobbyShop
terms.comment: A store that sells materials useful or necessary for various hobbies.

terms.label: HomeAndConstructionBusiness
terms.comment:
A construction business.

A HomeAndConstructionBusiness is a [[LocalBusiness]] that provides services around homes and buildings.

As a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

terms.label: HomeGoodsStore
terms.comment: A home goods store.

terms.label: Hospital
terms.comment: A hospital.

terms.label: Hostel
terms.comment:
A hostel - cheap accommodation, often in shared dormitories.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: Hotel
terms.comment:
A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging paid on a short-term basis (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotel).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: HotelRoom
terms.comment:
A hotel room is a single room in a hotel.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: House
terms.comment: A house is a building or structure that has the ability to be occupied for habitation by humans or other creatures (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House).

terms.label: HousePainter
terms.comment: A house painting service.

terms.label: HowTo
terms.comment: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

terms.label: HowToDirection
terms.comment: A direction indicating a single action to do in the instructions for how to achieve a result.

terms.label: HowToItem
terms.comment: An item used as either a tool or supply when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

terms.label: HowToSection
terms.comment: A sub-grouping of steps in the instructions for how to achieve a result (e.g. steps for making a pie crust within a pie recipe).

terms.label: HowToStep
terms.comment: A step in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It is an ordered list with HowToDirection and/or HowToTip items.

terms.label: HowToSupply
terms.comment: A supply consumed when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

terms.label: HowToTip
terms.comment: An explanation in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It provides supplementary information about a technique, supply, author's preference, etc. It can explain what could be done, or what should not be done, but doesn't specify what should be done (see HowToDirection).

terms.label: HowToTool
terms.comment: A tool used (but not consumed) when performing instructions for how to achieve a result.

terms.label: HyperToc
terms.comment: A HyperToc represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. Items in the table of contents are indicated using the [[tocEntry]] property, and typed [[HyperTocEntry]]. For cases where the same larger work is split into multiple files, [[associatedMedia]] can be used on individual [[HyperTocEntry]] items.

terms.label: HyperTocEntry
terms.comment: A HyperToEntry is an item within a [[HyperToc]], which represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. The media object itself is indicated using [[associatedMedia]]. Each section of interest within that content can be described with a [[HyperTocEntry]], with associated [[startOffset]] and [[endOffset]]. When several entries are all from the same file, [[associatedMedia]] is used on the overarching [[HyperTocEntry]]; if the content h…

terms.label: IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration
terms.comment: IPTC "Digital Source" codes for use with the [[digitalSourceType]] property, providing information about the source for a digital media object. In general these codes are not declared here to be mutually exclusive, although some combinations would be contradictory if applied simultaneously, or might be considered mutually incompatible by upstream maintainers of the definitions. See the IPTC

terms.label: ITNonprofitType
terms.comment: ITNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Italy. Most categories are drawn from the Italian Third Sector Code (Legislative Decree No. 117 of 3 July 2017), although some Italian non-profit entities, such as amateur sports entities, are primarily governed by other legislation.

terms.label: IceCreamShop
terms.comment: An ice cream shop.

terms.label: IgnoreAction
terms.comment: The act of intentionally disregarding the object. An agent ignores an object.

terms.label: ImageGallery
terms.comment: Web page type: Image gallery page.

terms.label: ImageObject
terms.comment: An image file.

terms.label: ImageObjectSnapshot
terms.comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an [[ImageObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata (e.g. XMP, EXIF) the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

terms.label: ImagingTest
terms.comment: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes.

terms.label: IncentiveQualifiedExpenseType
terms.comment: The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

terms.label: IncentiveStatus
terms.comment: Enumerates a status for an incentive, such as whether it is active.

terms.label: IncentiveType
terms.comment: Enumerates common financial incentives for products, including tax credits, tax deductions, rebates and subsidies, etc.

terms.label: IndividualPhysician
terms.comment: An individual medical practitioner. For their official address use [[address]], for affiliations to hospitals use [[hospitalAffiliation]]. The [[practicesAt]] property can be used to indicate [[MedicalOrganization]] hospitals, clinics, pharmacies etc. where this physician practices.

terms.label: IndividualProduct
terms.comment: A single, identifiable product instance (e.g. a laptop with a particular serial number).

terms.label: InfectiousAgentClass
terms.comment: Classes of agents or pathogens that transmit infectious diseases. Enumerated type.

terms.label: InfectiousDisease
terms.comment: An infectious disease is a clinically evident human disease resulting from the presence of pathogenic microbial agents, like pathogenic viruses, pathogenic bacteria, fungi, protozoa, multicellular parasites, and prions. To be considered an infectious disease, such pathogens are known to be able to cause this disease.

terms.label: InformAction
terms.comment: The act of notifying someone of information pertinent to them, with no expectation of a response.

terms.label: InsertAction
terms.comment: The act of adding at a specific location in an ordered collection.

terms.label: InstallAction
terms.comment: The act of installing an application.

terms.label: InstantaneousEvent
terms.comment: An event with no duration, like for instance a computer log entry.

terms.label: InsuranceAgency
terms.comment: An Insurance agency.

terms.label: Intangible
terms.comment: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things such as quantities, structured values, etc.

terms.label: Integer
terms.comment: Data type: Integer.

terms.label: InteractAction
terms.comment: The act of interacting with another person or organization.

terms.label: InteractionCounter
terms.comment: A summary of how users have interacted with this CreativeWork. In most cases, authors will use a subtype to specify the specific type of interaction.

terms.label: InternetCafe
terms.comment: An internet cafe.

terms.label: InvestmentFund
terms.comment: A company or fund that gathers capital from a number of investors to create a pool of money that is then re-invested into stocks, bonds and other assets.

terms.label: InvestmentOrDeposit
terms.comment: A type of financial product that typically requires the client to transfer funds to a financial service in return for potential beneficial financial return.

terms.label: InviteAction
terms.comment: The act of asking someone to attend an event. Reciprocal of RsvpAction.

terms.label: Invoice
terms.comment: A statement of the money due for goods or services; a bill.

terms.label: ItemAvailability
terms.comment: A list of possible product availability options.

terms.label: ItemList
terms.comment: A list of items of any sort—for example, Top 10 Movies About Weathermen, or Top 100 Party Songs. Not to be confused with HTML lists, which are often used only for formatting.

terms.label: ItemListOrderType
terms.comment: Enumerated for values for itemListOrder for indicating how an ordered ItemList is organized.

terms.label: ItemPage
terms.comment: A page devoted to a single item, such as a particular product or hotel.

terms.label: JewelryStore
terms.comment: A jewelry store.

terms.label: JobPosting
terms.comment: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

terms.label: JoinAction
terms.comment:
An agent joins an event/group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, JoinAction refers to joining a group/team of people.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be receiving updates.
* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be polling for updates.

terms.label: Joint
terms.comment: The anatomical location at which two or more bones make contact.

terms.label: LakeBodyOfWater
terms.comment: A lake (for example, Lake Pontrachain).

terms.label: Landform
terms.comment: A landform or physical feature. Landform elements include mountains, plains, lakes, rivers, seascape and oceanic waterbody interface features such as bays, peninsulas, seas and so forth, including sub-aqueous terrain features such as submersed mountain ranges, volcanoes, and the great ocean basins.

terms.label: LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings
terms.comment: An historical landmark or building.

terms.label: Language
terms.comment: Natural languages such as Spanish, Tamil, Hindi, English, etc. Formal language code tags expressed in [BCP 47](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) can be used via the [[alternateName]] property. The Language type previously also covered programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, which are now best represented using [[ComputerLanguage]].

terms.label: LearningResource
terms.comment: The LearningResource type can be used to indicate [[CreativeWork]]s (whether physical or digital) that have a particular and explicit orientation towards learning, education, skill acquisition, and other educational purposes. [[LearningResource]] is expected to be used as an addition to a primary type such as [[Book]], [[VideoObject]], [[Product]] etc. [[EducationEvent]] serves a similar purpose for event-like things (e.g. a [[Trip]]). A [[LearningResource]] may be created as a result of an [[E…

terms.label: LeaveAction
terms.comment:
An agent leaves an event / group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: The antonym of LeaveAction.
* [[UnRegisterAction]]: Unlike UnRegisterAction, LeaveAction implies leaving a group/team of people rather than a service.

terms.label: LegalForceStatus
terms.comment: A list of possible statuses for the legal force of a legislation.

terms.label: LegalService
terms.comment: A LegalService is a business that provides legally-oriented services, advice and representation, e.g. law firms.\n\nAs a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

terms.label: LegalValueLevel
terms.comment: A list of possible levels for the legal validity of a legislation.

terms.label: Legislation
terms.comment: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

terms.label: LegislationObject
terms.comment: A specific object or file containing a Legislation. Note that the same Legislation can be published in multiple files. For example, a digitally signed PDF, a plain PDF and an HTML version.

terms.label: LegislativeBuilding
terms.comment: A legislative building—for example, the state capitol.

terms.label: LendAction
terms.comment:
The act of providing an object under an agreement that it will be returned at a later date. Reciprocal of BorrowAction.

Related actions:

* [[BorrowAction]]: Reciprocal of LendAction.

terms.label: Library
terms.comment: A library.

terms.label: LibrarySystem
terms.comment: A [[LibrarySystem]] is a collaborative system amongst several libraries.

terms.label: LifestyleModification
terms.comment: A process of care involving exercise, changes to diet, fitness routines, and other lifestyle changes aimed at improving a health condition.

terms.label: Ligament
terms.comment: A short band of tough, flexible, fibrous connective tissue that functions to connect multiple bones, cartilages, and structurally support joints.

terms.label: LikeAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a positive sentiment about the object. An agent likes an object (a proposition, topic or theme) with participants.

terms.label: LinkRole
terms.comment: A Role that represents a Web link, e.g. as expressed via the 'url' property. Its linkRelationship property can indicate URL-based and plain textual link types, e.g. those in IANA link registry or others such as 'amphtml'. This structure provides a placeholder where details from HTML's link element can be represented outside of HTML, e.g. in JSON-LD feeds.

terms.label: LiquorStore
terms.comment: A shop that sells alcoholic drinks such as wine, beer, whisky and other spirits.

terms.label: ListItem
terms.comment: An list item, e.g. a step in a checklist or how-to description.

terms.label: ListenAction
terms.comment: The act of consuming audio content.

terms.label: LiteraryEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Literary event.

terms.label: LiveBlogPosting
terms.comment: A [[LiveBlogPosting]] is a [[BlogPosting]] intended to provide a rolling textual coverage of an ongoing event through continuous updates.

terms.label: LoanOrCredit
terms.comment: A financial product for the loaning of an amount of money, or line of credit, under agreed terms and charges.

terms.label: LocalBusiness
terms.comment: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

terms.label: LocationFeatureSpecification
terms.comment: Specifies a location feature by providing a structured value representing a feature of an accommodation as a property-value pair of varying degrees of formality.

terms.label: Locksmith
terms.comment: A locksmith.

terms.label: LodgingBusiness
terms.comment: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

terms.label: LodgingReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for lodging at a hotel, motel, inn, etc.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

terms.label: LoginAction
terms.comment: The action of logging into a device or application.

terms.label: LoseAction
terms.comment: The act of being defeated in a competitive activity.

terms.label: LymphaticVessel
terms.comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries lymph fluid unidirectionally toward the heart.

terms.label: Manuscript
terms.comment: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed.

terms.label: Map
terms.comment: A map.

terms.label: MapCategoryType
terms.comment: An enumeration of several kinds of Map.

terms.label: MarryAction
terms.comment: The act of marrying a person.

terms.label: Mass
terms.comment: Properties that take Mass as values are of the form '<Number> <Mass unit of measure>'. E.g., '7 kg'.

terms.label: MathSolver
terms.comment: A math solver which is capable of solving a subset of mathematical problems.

terms.label: MaximumDoseSchedule
terms.comment: The maximum dosing schedule considered safe for a drug or supplement as recommended by an authority or by the drug/supplement's manufacturer. Capture the recommending authority in the recognizingAuthority property of MedicalEntity.

terms.label: MeasurementMethodEnum
terms.comment: Enumeration(s) for use with [[measurementMethod]].

terms.label: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumeration of common measurement types (or dimensions), for example "chest" for a person, "inseam" for pants, "gauge" for screws, or "wheel" for bicycles.

terms.label: MediaEnumeration
terms.comment: MediaEnumeration enumerations are lists of codes, labels etc. useful for describing media objects. They may be reflections of externally developed lists, or created at schema.org, or a combination.

terms.label: MediaGallery
terms.comment: Web page type: Media gallery page. A mixed-media page that can contain media such as images, videos, and other multimedia.

terms.label: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
