terms.comment: Codes for use with the [[mediaAuthenticityCategory]] property, indicating the authenticity of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared). In general these codes are not mutually exclusive, although some combinations (such as 'original' versus 'transformed', 'edited' and 'staged') would be contradictory if applied in the same [[MediaReview]]. Note that the application of these codes is with regard to a piece of media shared or published in a particular context.

terms.label: MediaObject
terms.comment: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single song (MusicRecording) may have a music video (VideoObject), and a high and low bandwidth audio stream (2 AudioObject's).

terms.label: MediaReview
terms.comment: A [[MediaReview]] is a more specialized form of Review dedicated to the evaluation of media content online, typically in the context of fact-checking and misinformation. For more general reviews of media in the broader sense, use [[UserReview]], [[CriticReview]] or other [[Review]] types. This definition is a work in progress. While the [[MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration]] list reflects significant community review amongst fact-checkers and others working to combat misinformation, the specifi…

terms.label: MediaReviewItem
terms.comment: Represents an item or group of closely related items treated as a unit for the sake of evaluation in a [[MediaReview]]. Authorship etc. apply to the items rather than to the curation/grouping or reviewing party.

terms.label: MediaSubscription
terms.comment: A subscription which allows a user to access media including audio, video, books, etc.

terms.label: MedicalAudience
terms.comment: Target audiences for medical web pages.

terms.label: MedicalAudienceType
terms.comment: Target audiences types for medical web pages. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalBusiness
terms.comment: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

terms.label: MedicalCause
terms.comment: The causative agent(s) that are responsible for the pathophysiologic process that eventually results in a medical condition, symptom or sign. In this schema, unless otherwise specified this is meant to be the proximate cause of the medical condition, symptom or sign. The proximate cause is defined as the causative agent that most directly results in the medical condition, symptom or sign. For example, the HIV virus could be considered a cause of AIDS. Or in a diagnostic context, if a patient fe…

terms.label: MedicalClinic
terms.comment: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

terms.label: MedicalCode
terms.comment: A code for a medical entity.

terms.label: MedicalCondition
terms.comment: Any condition of the human body that affects the normal functioning of a person, whether physically or mentally. Includes diseases, injuries, disabilities, disorders, syndromes, etc.

terms.label: MedicalConditionStage
terms.comment: A stage of a medical condition, such as 'Stage IIIa'.

terms.label: MedicalContraindication
terms.comment: A condition or factor that serves as a reason to withhold a certain medical therapy. Contraindications can be absolute (there are no reasonable circumstances for undertaking a course of action) or relative (the patient is at higher risk of complications, but these risks may be outweighed by other considerations or mitigated by other measures).

terms.label: MedicalDevice
terms.comment: Any object used in a medical capacity, such as to diagnose or treat a patient.

terms.label: MedicalDevicePurpose
terms.comment: Categories of medical devices, organized by the purpose or intended use of the device.

terms.label: MedicalEntity
terms.comment: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

terms.label: MedicalEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerations related to health and the practice of medicine: A concept that is used to attribute a quality to another concept, as a qualifier, a collection of items or a listing of all of the elements of a set in medicine practice.

terms.label: MedicalEvidenceLevel
terms.comment: Level of evidence for a medical guideline. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalGuideline
terms.comment: Any recommendation made by a standard society (e.g. ACC/AHA) or consensus statement that denotes how to diagnose and treat a particular condition. Note: this type should be used to tag the actual guideline recommendation; if the guideline recommendation occurs in a larger scholarly article, use MedicalScholarlyArticle to tag the overall article, not this type. Note also: the organization making the recommendation should be captured in the recognizingAuthority base property of MedicalEntity.

terms.label: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
terms.comment: A guideline contraindication that designates a process as harmful and where quality of the data supporting the contraindication is sound.

terms.label: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
terms.comment: A guideline recommendation that is regarded as efficacious and where quality of the data supporting the recommendation is sound.

terms.label: MedicalImagingTechnique
terms.comment: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalIndication
terms.comment: A condition or factor that indicates use of a medical therapy, including signs, symptoms, risk factors, anatomical states, etc.

terms.label: MedicalIntangible
terms.comment: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things in the medical space.

terms.label: MedicalObservationalStudy
terms.comment: An observational study is a type of medical study that attempts to infer the possible effect of a treatment through observation of a cohort of subjects over a period of time. In an observational study, the assignment of subjects into treatment groups versus control groups is outside the control of the investigator. This is in contrast with controlled studies, such as the randomized controlled trials represented by MedicalTrial, where each subject is randomly assigned to a treatment group or a c…

terms.label: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
terms.comment: Design models for observational medical studies. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalOrganization
terms.comment: A medical organization (physical or not), such as hospital, institution or clinic.

terms.label: MedicalProcedure
terms.comment: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

terms.label: MedicalProcedureType
terms.comment: An enumeration that describes different types of medical procedures.

terms.label: MedicalRiskCalculator
terms.comment: A complex mathematical calculation requiring an online calculator, used to assess prognosis. Note: use the url property of Thing to record any URLs for online calculators.

terms.label: MedicalRiskEstimator
terms.comment: Any rule set or interactive tool for estimating the risk of developing a complication or condition.

terms.label: MedicalRiskFactor
terms.comment: A risk factor is anything that increases a person's likelihood of developing or contracting a disease, medical condition, or complication.

terms.label: MedicalRiskScore
terms.comment: A simple system that adds up the number of risk factors to yield a score that is associated with prognosis, e.g. CHAD score, TIMI risk score.

terms.label: MedicalScholarlyArticle
terms.comment: A scholarly article in the medical domain.

terms.label: MedicalSign
terms.comment: Any physical manifestation of a person's medical condition discoverable by objective diagnostic tests or physical examination.

terms.label: MedicalSignOrSymptom
terms.comment: Any feature associated or not with a medical condition. In medicine a symptom is generally subjective while a sign is objective.

terms.label: MedicalSpecialty
terms.comment: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalStudy
terms.comment: A medical study is an umbrella type covering all kinds of research studies relating to human medicine or health, including observational studies and interventional trials and registries, randomized, controlled or not. When the specific type of study is known, use one of the extensions of this type, such as MedicalTrial or MedicalObservationalStudy. Also, note that this type should be used to mark up data that describes the study itself; to tag an article that publishes the results of a study, u…

terms.label: MedicalStudyStatus
terms.comment: The status of a medical study. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalSymptom
terms.comment: Any complaint sensed and expressed by the patient (therefore defined as subjective) like stomachache, lower-back pain, or fatigue.

terms.label: MedicalTest
terms.comment: Any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes.

terms.label: MedicalTestPanel
terms.comment: Any collection of tests commonly ordered together.

terms.label: MedicalTherapy
terms.comment: Any medical intervention designed to prevent, treat, and cure human diseases and medical conditions, including both curative and palliative therapies. Medical therapies are typically processes of care relying upon pharmacotherapy, behavioral therapy, supportive therapy (with fluid or nutrition for example), or detoxification (e.g. hemodialysis) aimed at improving or preventing a health condition.

terms.label: MedicalTrial
terms.comment: A medical trial is a type of medical study that uses a scientific process to compare the safety and efficacy of medical therapies or medical procedures. In general, medical trials are controlled and subjects are allocated at random to the different treatment and/or control groups.

terms.label: MedicalTrialDesign
terms.comment: Design models for medical trials. Enumerated type.

terms.label: MedicalWebPage
terms.comment: A web page that provides medical information.

terms.label: MedicineSystem
terms.comment: Systems of medical practice.

terms.label: MeetingRoom
terms.comment:
A meeting room, conference room, or conference hall is a room provided for singular events such as business conferences and meetings (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conference_hall).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: MemberProgram
terms.comment: A MemberProgram defines a loyalty (or membership) program that provides its members with certain benefits, for example better pricing, free shipping or returns, or the ability to earn loyalty points. Member programs may have multiple tiers, for example silver and gold members, each with different benefits.

terms.label: MemberProgramTier
terms.comment: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

terms.label: MensClothingStore
terms.comment: A men's clothing store.

terms.label: Menu
terms.comment: A structured representation of food or drink items available from a FoodEstablishment.

terms.label: MenuItem
terms.comment: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

terms.label: MenuSection
terms.comment: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

terms.label: MerchantReturnEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates several kinds of product return policies.

terms.label: MerchantReturnPolicy
terms.comment: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]], [[Product]], or [[Offer]].

terms.label: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
terms.comment: A seasonal override of a return policy, for example used for holidays.

terms.label: Message
terms.comment: A single message from a sender to one or more organizations or people.

terms.label: MiddleSchool
terms.comment: A middle school (typically for children aged around 11-14, although this varies somewhat).

terms.label: MobileApplication
terms.comment: A software application designed specifically to work well on a mobile device such as a telephone.

terms.label: MobilePhoneStore
terms.comment: A store that sells mobile phones and related accessories.

terms.label: MolecularEntity
terms.comment: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.

terms.label: MonetaryAmount
terms.comment: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use [[PriceSpecification]] Types to describe the price of an Offer, Invoice, etc.

terms.label: MonetaryAmountDistribution
terms.comment: A statistical distribution of monetary amounts.

terms.label: MonetaryGrant
terms.comment: A monetary grant.

terms.label: MoneyTransfer
terms.comment: The act of transferring money from one place to another place. This may occur electronically or physically.

terms.label: MortgageLoan
terms.comment: A loan in which property or real estate is used as collateral. (A loan securitized against some real estate.)

terms.label: Mosque
terms.comment: A mosque.

terms.label: Motel
terms.comment:
A motel.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: Motorcycle
terms.comment: A motorcycle or motorbike is a single-track, two-wheeled motor vehicle.

terms.label: MotorcycleDealer
terms.comment: A motorcycle dealer.

terms.label: MotorcycleRepair
terms.comment: A motorcycle repair shop.

terms.label: MotorizedBicycle
terms.comment: A motorized bicycle is a bicycle with an attached motor used to power the vehicle, or to assist with pedaling.

terms.label: Mountain
terms.comment: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

terms.label: MoveAction
terms.comment:
The act of an agent relocating to a place.

Related actions:

* [[TransferAction]]: Unlike TransferAction, the subject of the move is a living Person or Organization rather than an inanimate object.

terms.label: Movie
terms.comment: A movie.

terms.label: MovieClip
terms.comment: A short segment/part of a movie.

terms.label: MovieRentalStore
terms.comment: A movie rental store.

terms.label: MovieSeries
terms.comment: A series of movies. Included movies can be indicated with the hasPart property.

terms.label: MovieTheater
terms.comment: A movie theater.

terms.label: MovingCompany
terms.comment: A moving company.

terms.label: Muscle
terms.comment: A muscle is an anatomical structure consisting of a contractile form of tissue that animals use to effect movement.

terms.label: Museum
terms.comment: A museum.

terms.label: MusicAlbum
terms.comment: A collection of music tracks.

terms.label: MusicAlbumProductionType
terms.comment: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

terms.label: MusicAlbumReleaseType
terms.comment: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

terms.label: MusicComposition
terms.comment: A musical composition.

terms.label: MusicEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Music event.

terms.label: MusicGroup
terms.comment: A musical group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a choir. Can also be a solo musician.

terms.label: MusicPlaylist
terms.comment: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

terms.label: MusicRecording
terms.comment: A music recording (track), usually a single song.

terms.label: MusicRelease
terms.comment: A MusicRelease is a specific release of a music album.

terms.label: MusicReleaseFormatType
terms.comment: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

terms.label: MusicStore
terms.comment: A music store.

terms.label: MusicVenue
terms.comment: A music venue.

terms.label: MusicVideoObject
terms.comment: A music video file.

terms.label: NGO
terms.comment: Organization: Non-governmental Organization.

terms.label: NLNonprofitType
terms.comment: NLNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the Netherlands.

terms.label: NailSalon
terms.comment: A nail salon.

terms.label: Nerve
terms.comment: A common pathway for the electrochemical nerve impulses that are transmitted along each of the axons.

terms.label: NewsArticle
terms.comment: A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news. A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

terms.label: NewsMediaOrganization
terms.comment: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

terms.label: Newspaper
terms.comment: A publication containing information about varied topics that are pertinent to general information, a geographic area, or a specific subject matter (i.e. business, culture, education). Often published daily.

terms.label: NightClub
terms.comment: A nightclub or discotheque.

terms.label: NonprofitType
terms.comment: NonprofitType enumerates several kinds of official non-profit types of which a non-profit organization can be.

terms.label: Notary
terms.comment: A notary.

terms.label: NoteDigitalDocument
terms.comment: A file containing a note, primarily for the author.

terms.label: Number
terms.comment:
Data type: Number.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

terms.label: NutritionInformation
terms.comment: Nutritional information about the recipe.

terms.label: Observation
terms.comment: Instances of the class [[Observation]] are used to specify observations about an entity at a particular time. The principal properties of an [[Observation]] are [[observationAbout]], [[measuredProperty]], [[statType]], [[value] and [[observationDate]] and [[measuredProperty]]. Some but not all Observations represent a [[QuantitativeValue]]. Quantitative observations can be about a [[StatisticalVariable]], which is an abstract specification about which we can make observations that are grounded …

terms.label: Occupation
terms.comment: A profession, may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification.

terms.label: OccupationalExperienceRequirements
terms.comment: Indicates employment-related experience requirements, e.g. [[monthsOfExperience]].

terms.label: OccupationalTherapy
terms.comment: A treatment of people with physical, emotional, or social problems, using purposeful activity to help them overcome or learn to deal with their problems.

terms.label: OceanBodyOfWater
terms.comment: An ocean (for example, the Pacific).

terms.label: Offer
terms.comment:
An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

Note: As the [[businessFunction]] property, which identifies the form of offer (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose), defaults to http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell; an Offer without a defined businessFunction value can be assumed to be an offer to sell.

For [G…

terms.label: OfferCatalog
terms.comment: An OfferCatalog is an ItemList that contains related Offers and/or further OfferCatalogs that are offeredBy the same provider.

terms.label: OfferForLease
terms.comment: An [[OfferForLease]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to lease out something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose [[businessFunction]] is [lease out](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#LeaseOut.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for background on the underlying concepts.

terms.label: OfferForPurchase
terms.comment: An [[OfferForPurchase]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to sell something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose [[businessFunction]] is [sell](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for background on the underlying concepts.

terms.label: OfferItemCondition
terms.comment: A list of possible conditions for the item.

terms.label: OfferShippingDetails
terms.comment: OfferShippingDetails represents information about shipping destinations. Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping rates for different destinations: One entity for Alaska/Hawaii. A different one for continental US. A different one for all France. Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping costs and delivery times. Two entities that are identical but differ in rate and time: E.g. Cheaper and slower: $5 in 5-7 days or Fast and expensive: $1…

terms.label: OfficeEquipmentStore
terms.comment: An office equipment store.

terms.label: OnDemandEvent
terms.comment: A publication event, e.g. catch-up TV or radio podcast, during which a program is available on-demand.

terms.label: OnlineBusiness
terms.comment: A particular online business, either standalone or the online part of a broader organization. Examples include an eCommerce site, an online travel booking site, an online learning site, an online logistics and shipping provider, an online (virtual) doctor, etc.

terms.label: OnlineMarketplace
terms.comment: An eCommerce marketplace.

terms.label: OnlineStore
terms.comment: An eCommerce site.

terms.label: OpeningHoursSpecification
terms.comment:
A structured value providing information about the opening hours of a place or a certain service inside a place.

 The place is __open__ if the [[opens]] property is specified, and __closed__ otherwise.

If the value for the [[closes]] property is less than the value for the [[opens]] property then the hour range is assumed to span over the next day.

terms.label: OperatingSystem
terms.comment: System software that manages computer hardware and software resources, and provides common services for computer programs.

terms.label: OpinionNewsArticle
terms.comment: An [[OpinionNewsArticle]] is a [[NewsArticle]] that primarily expresses opinions rather than journalistic reporting of news and events. For example, a [[NewsArticle]] consisting of a column or [[Blog]]/[[BlogPosting]] entry in the Opinions section of a news publication.

terms.label: Optician
terms.comment: A store that sells reading glasses and similar devices for improving vision.

terms.label: Order
terms.comment: An order is a confirmation of a transaction (a receipt), which can contain multiple line items, each represented by an Offer that has been accepted by the customer.

terms.label: OrderAction
terms.comment: An agent orders an object/product/service to be delivered/sent.

terms.label: OrderItem
terms.comment: An order item is a line of an order. It includes the quantity and shipping details of a bought offer.

terms.label: OrderStatus
terms.comment: Enumerated status values for Order.

terms.label: Organization
terms.comment: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

terms.label: OrganizationRole
terms.comment: A subclass of Role used to describe roles within organizations.

terms.label: OrganizeAction
terms.comment: The act of manipulating/administering/supervising/controlling one or more objects.

terms.label: OutletStore
terms.comment: An outlet store.

terms.label: OwnershipInfo
terms.comment: A structured value providing information about when a certain organization or person owned a certain product.

terms.label: PaintAction
terms.comment: The act of producing a painting, typically with paint and canvas as instruments.

terms.label: Painting
terms.comment: A painting.

terms.label: PalliativeProcedure
terms.comment: A medical procedure intended primarily for palliative purposes, aimed at relieving the symptoms of an underlying health condition.

terms.label: ParcelDelivery
terms.comment: The delivery of a parcel either via the postal service or a commercial service.

terms.label: ParentAudience
terms.comment: A set of characteristics describing parents, who can be interested in viewing some content.

terms.label: Park
terms.comment: A park.

terms.label: ParkingFacility
terms.comment: A parking lot or other parking facility.

terms.label: PathologyTest
terms.comment: A medical test performed by a laboratory that typically involves examination of a tissue sample by a pathologist.

terms.label: Patient
terms.comment: A patient is any person recipient of health care services.

terms.label: PawnShop
terms.comment: A shop that will buy, or lend money against the security of, personal possessions.

terms.label: PayAction
terms.comment: An agent pays a price to a participant.

terms.label: PaymentCard
terms.comment: A payment method using a credit, debit, store or other card to associate the payment with an account.

terms.label: PaymentChargeSpecification
terms.comment: The costs of settling the payment using a particular payment method.

terms.label: PaymentMethod
terms.comment:
A payment method is a standardized procedure for transferring the monetary amount for a purchase. Payment methods are characterized by the legal and technical structures used, and by the organization or group carrying out the transaction. The following legacy values should be accepted: 

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByBankTransferInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByInvoice
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Cash
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#CheckInAdvance
* http://p…

terms.label: PaymentMethodType
terms.comment: The type of payment method, only for generic payment types, specific forms of payments, like card payment should be expressed using subclasses of PaymentMethod.

terms.label: PaymentService
terms.comment: A Service to transfer funds from a person or organization to a beneficiary person or organization.

terms.label: PaymentStatusType
terms.comment: A specific payment status. For example, PaymentDue, PaymentComplete, etc.

terms.label: PeopleAudience
terms.comment: A set of characteristics belonging to people, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

terms.label: PerformAction
terms.comment: The act of participating in performance arts.

terms.label: PerformanceRole
terms.comment: A PerformanceRole is a Role that some entity places with regard to a theatrical performance, e.g. in a Movie, TVSeries etc.

terms.label: PerformingArtsEvent
terms.comment:
Live performance Event of the performing arts (music, theatre, dance, acrobatics, spoken word), including performance art and performative sports (e.g. choreographed forms of martial arts, figure skating, competitive ballroom dancing).

Note: Use additionalType to differentiate between productions / shows (PerformanceWork, EventSeries), tours (EventSeries), and individual…

terms.label: PerformingArtsTheater
terms.comment: A theater or other performing art center.

terms.label: PerformingGroup
terms.comment: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

terms.label: Periodical
terms.comment: A publication in any medium issued in successive parts bearing numerical or chronological designations and intended to continue indefinitely, such as a magazine, scholarly journal, or newspaper.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

terms.label: Permit
terms.comment: A permit issued by an organization, e.g. a parking pass.

terms.label: Person
terms.comment: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

terms.label: PetStore
terms.comment: A pet store.

terms.label: Pharmacy
terms.comment: A pharmacy or drugstore.

terms.label: Photograph
terms.comment: A photograph.

terms.label: PhotographAction
terms.comment: The act of capturing still images of objects using a camera.

terms.label: PhysicalActivity
terms.comment: Any bodily activity that enhances or maintains physical fitness and overall health and wellness. Includes activity that is part of daily living and routine, structured exercise, and exercise prescribed as part of a medical treatment or recovery plan.

terms.label: PhysicalActivityCategory
terms.comment: Categories of physical activity, organized by physiologic classification.

terms.label: PhysicalExam
terms.comment: A type of physical examination of a patient performed by a physician.

terms.label: PhysicalTherapy
terms.comment: A process of progressive physical care and rehabilitation aimed at improving a health condition.

terms.label: Physician
terms.comment: An individual physician or a physician's office considered as a [[MedicalOrganization]].

terms.label: PhysiciansOffice
terms.comment: A doctor's office or clinic.

terms.label: Place
terms.comment: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

terms.label: PlaceOfWorship
terms.comment: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

terms.label: PlanAction
terms.comment: The act of planning the execution of an event/task/action/reservation/plan to a future date.

terms.label: Play
terms.comment: A play is a form of literature, usually consisting of dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than just reading. Note: A performance of a Play would be a [[TheaterEvent]] or [[BroadcastEvent]] - the *Play* being the [[workPerformed]].

terms.label: PlayAction
terms.comment:
The act of playing/exercising/training/performing for enjoyment, leisure, recreation, competition or exercise.

Related actions:

* [[ListenAction]]: Unlike ListenAction (which is under ConsumeAction), PlayAction refers to performing for an audience or at an event, rather than consuming music.
* [[WatchAction]]: Unlike WatchAction (which is under ConsumeAction), PlayAction refers to showing/displaying for an audience or at an event, rather than consuming visual content.

terms.label: PlayGameAction
terms.comment: The act of playing a video game.

terms.label: Playground
terms.comment: A playground.

terms.label: Plumber
terms.comment: A plumbing service.

terms.label: PodcastEpisode
terms.comment: A single episode of a podcast series.

terms.label: PodcastSeason
terms.comment: A single season of a podcast. Many podcasts do not break down into separate seasons. In that case, PodcastSeries should be used.

terms.label: PodcastSeries
terms.comment: A podcast is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to.

terms.label: PoliceStation
terms.comment: A police station.

terms.label: PoliticalParty
terms.comment: Organization: Political Party.

terms.label: Pond
terms.comment: A pond.

terms.label: PostOffice
terms.comment: A post office.

terms.label: PostalAddress
terms.comment: The mailing address.

terms.label: PostalCodeRangeSpecification
terms.comment: Indicates a range of postal codes, usually defined as the set of valid codes between [[postalCodeBegin]] and [[postalCodeEnd]], inclusively.

terms.label: Poster
terms.comment: A large, usually printed placard, bill, or announcement, often illustrated, that is posted to advertise or publicize something.

terms.label: PreOrderAction
terms.comment: An agent orders a (not yet released) object/product/service to be delivered/sent.

terms.label: PrependAction
terms.comment: The act of inserting at the beginning if an ordered collection.

terms.label: Preschool
terms.comment: A preschool.

terms.label: PresentationDigitalDocument
terms.comment: A file containing slides or used for a presentation.

terms.label: PreventionIndication
terms.comment: An indication for preventing an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

terms.label: PriceComponentTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates different price components that together make up the total price for an offered product.

terms.label: PriceSpecification
terms.comment: A structured value representing a price or price range. Typically, only the subclasses of this type are used for markup. It is recommended to use [[MonetaryAmount]] to describe independent amounts of money such as a salary, credit card limits, etc.

terms.label: PriceTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates different price types, for example list price, invoice price, and sale price.

terms.label: Product
terms.comment: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.

terms.label: ProductCollection
terms.comment: A set of products (either [[ProductGroup]]s or specific variants) that are listed together e.g. in an [[Offer]].

terms.label: ProductGroup
terms.comment: A ProductGroup represents a group of [[Product]]s that vary only in certain well-described ways, such as by [[size]], [[color]], [[material]] etc. While a ProductGroup itself is not directly offered for sale, the various varying products that it represents can be. The ProductGroup serves as a prototype or template, standing in for all of the products who have an [[isVariantOf]] relationship to it. As such, properties (including additional types) can be applied to the ProductGroup to represent c…

terms.label: ProductModel
terms.comment: A datasheet or vendor specification of a product (in the sense of a prototypical description).

terms.label: ProductReturnEnumeration
terms.comment: ProductReturnEnumeration enumerates several kinds of product return policy. Note that this structure may not capture all aspects of the policy.

terms.label: ProductReturnPolicy
terms.comment: A ProductReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]] or [[Product]].

terms.label: ProfessionalService
terms.comment: Original definition: "provider of professional services."\n\nThe general [[ProfessionalService]] type for local businesses was deprecated due to confusion with [[Service]]. For reference, the types that it included were: [[Dentist]], [[AccountingService]], [[Attorney]], [[Notary]], as well as types for several kinds of [[HomeAndConstructionBusiness]]: [[Electrician]], [[GeneralContractor]], [[HousePainter]], [[Locksmith]], [[Plumber]], [[RoofingContractor]]. [[LegalService]] was introduced as a…

terms.label: ProfilePage
terms.comment: Web page type: Profile page.

terms.label: ProgramMembership
terms.comment: Used to describe membership in a loyalty programs (e.g. "StarAliance"), traveler clubs (e.g. "AAA"), purchase clubs ("Safeway Club"), etc.

terms.label: Project
terms.comment: An enterprise (potentially individual but typically collaborative), planned to achieve a particular aim. Use properties from [[Organization]], [[subOrganization]]/[[parentOrganization]] to indicate project sub-structures.

terms.label: PronounceableText
terms.comment: Data type: PronounceableText.

terms.label: Property
terms.comment: A property, used to indicate attributes and relationships of some Thing; equivalent to rdf:Property.

terms.label: PropertyValue
terms.comment: A property-value pair, e.g. representing a feature of a product or place. Use the 'name' property for the name of the property. If there is an additional human-readable version of the value, put that into the 'description' property.\n\n Always use specific schema.org properties when a) they exist and b) you can populate them. Using PropertyValue as a substitute will typically not trigger the same effect as using the original, specific property.

terms.label: PropertyValueSpecification
terms.comment: A Property value specification.

terms.label: Protein
terms.comment: Protein is here used in its widest possible definition, as classes of amino acid based molecules. Amyloid-beta Protein in human (UniProt P05067), eukaryota (e.g. an OrthoDB group) or even a single molecule that one can point to are all of type :Protein. A protein can thus be a subclass of another protein, e.g. :Protein as a UniProt record can have multiple isoforms inside it which would also be :Protein. They can be imagined, synthetic, hypothetical or naturally occurring.

terms.label: PsychologicalTreatment
terms.comment: A process of care relying upon counseling, dialogue and communication aimed at improving a mental health condition without use of drugs.

terms.label: PublicSwimmingPool
terms.comment: A public swimming pool.

terms.label: PublicToilet
terms.comment: A public toilet is a room or small building containing one or more toilets (and possibly also urinals) which is available for use by the general public, or by customers or employees of certain businesses.

terms.label: PublicationEvent
terms.comment: A PublicationEvent corresponds indifferently to the event of publication for a CreativeWork of any type, e.g. a broadcast event, an on-demand event, a book/journal publication via a variety of delivery media.

terms.label: PublicationIssue
terms.comment: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or publication volume, often numbered, usually containing a grouping of works such as articles.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

terms.label: PublicationVolume
terms.comment: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or multi-volume work, often numbered. It may represent a time span, such as a year.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

terms.label: PurchaseType
terms.comment: Enumerates a purchase type for an item.

terms.label: QAPage
terms.comment: A QAPage is a WebPage focussed on a specific Question and its Answer(s), e.g. in a question answering site or documenting Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs).

terms.label: QualitativeValue
terms.comment: A predefined value for a product characteristic, e.g. the power cord plug type 'US' or the garment sizes 'S', 'M', 'L', and 'XL'.

terms.label: QuantitativeValue
terms.comment: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes.

terms.label: QuantitativeValueDistribution
terms.comment: A statistical distribution of values.

terms.label: Quantity
terms.comment: Quantities such as distance, time, mass, weight, etc. Particular instances of say Mass are strings like '3 kg' or '4 milligrams'.

terms.label: Question
terms.comment: A specific question - e.g. from a user seeking answers online, or collected in a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document.

terms.label: Quiz
terms.comment: Quiz: A test of knowledge, skills and abilities.

terms.label: Quotation
terms.comment: A quotation. Often but not necessarily from some written work, attributable to a real world author and - if associated with a fictional character - to any fictional Person. Use [[isBasedOn]] to link to source/origin. The [[recordedIn]] property can be used to reference a Quotation from an [[Event]].

terms.label: QuoteAction
terms.comment: An agent quotes/estimates/appraises an object/product/service with a price at a location/store.

terms.label: RVPark
terms.comment: A place offering space for "Recreational Vehicles", Caravans, mobile homes and the like.

terms.label: RadiationTherapy
terms.comment: A process of care using radiation aimed at improving a health condition.

terms.label: RadioBroadcastService
terms.comment: A delivery service through which radio content is provided via broadcast over the air or online.

terms.label: RadioChannel
terms.comment: A unique instance of a radio BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

terms.label: RadioClip
terms.comment: A short radio program or a segment/part of a radio program.

terms.label: RadioEpisode
terms.comment: A radio episode which can be part of a series or season.

terms.label: RadioSeason
terms.comment: Season dedicated to radio broadcast and associated online delivery.

terms.label: RadioSeries
terms.comment: CreativeWorkSeries dedicated to radio broadcast and associated online delivery.

terms.label: RadioStation
terms.comment: A radio station.

terms.label: Rating
terms.comment: A rating is an evaluation on a numeric scale, such as 1 to 5 stars.

terms.label: ReactAction
terms.comment: The act of responding instinctively and emotionally to an object, expressing a sentiment.

terms.label: ReadAction
terms.comment: The act of consuming written content.

terms.label: RealEstateAgent
terms.comment: A real-estate agent.

terms.label: RealEstateListing
terms.comment: A [[RealEstateListing]] is a listing that describes one or more real-estate [[Offer]]s (whose [[businessFunction]] is typically to lease out, or to sell). The [[RealEstateListing]] type itself represents the overall listing, as manifested in some [[WebPage]].

terms.label: ReceiveAction
terms.comment:
The act of physically/electronically taking delivery of an object that has been transferred from an origin to a destination. Reciprocal of SendAction.

Related actions:

* [[SendAction]]: The reciprocal of ReceiveAction.
* [[TakeAction]]: Unlike TakeAction, ReceiveAction does not imply that the ownership has been transferred (e.g. I can receive a package, but it does not mean the package is now mine).

terms.label: Recipe
terms.comment: A recipe. For dietary restrictions covered by the recipe, a few common restrictions are enumerated via [[suitableForDiet]]. The [[keywords]] property can also be used to add more detail.

terms.label: Recommendation
terms.comment: [[Recommendation]] is a type of [[Review]] that suggests or proposes something as the best option or best course of action. Recommendations may be for products or services, or other concrete things, as in the case of a ranked list or product guide. A [[Guide]] may list multiple recommendations for different categories. For example, in a [[Guide]] about which TVs to buy, the author may have several [[Recommendation]]s.

terms.label: RecommendedDoseSchedule
terms.comment: A recommended dosing schedule for a drug or supplement as prescribed or recommended by an authority or by the drug/supplement's manufacturer. Capture the recommending authority in the recognizingAuthority property of MedicalEntity.

terms.label: RecyclingCenter
terms.comment: A recycling center.

terms.label: RefundTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates several kinds of product return refund types.

terms.label: RegisterAction
terms.comment:
The act of registering to be a user of a service, product or web page.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, RegisterAction implies you are registering to be a user of a service, *not* a group/team of people.
* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, RegisterAction doesn't imply that the agent is expecting to poll for updates from the object.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, RegisterAction doesn't imply that the agent is expecting updates from the object.

terms.label: RejectAction
terms.comment:
The act of rejecting to/adopting an object.

Related actions:

* [[AcceptAction]]: The antonym of RejectAction.

terms.label: RentAction
terms.comment: The act of giving money in return for temporary use, but not ownership, of an object such as a vehicle or property. For example, an agent rents a property from a landlord in exchange for a periodic payment.

terms.label: RentalCarReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for a rental car.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations.

terms.label: RepaymentSpecification
terms.comment: A structured value representing repayment.

terms.label: ReplaceAction
terms.comment: The act of editing a recipient by replacing an old object with a new object.

terms.label: ReplyAction
terms.comment:
The act of responding to a question/message asked/sent by the object. Related to [[AskAction]].

Related actions:

* [[AskAction]]: Appears generally as an origin of a ReplyAction.

terms.label: Report
terms.comment: A Report generated by governmental or non-governmental organization.

terms.label: ReportageNewsArticle
terms.comment: The [[ReportageNewsArticle]] type is a subtype of [[NewsArticle]] representing news articles which are the result of journalistic news reporting conventions. In practice many news publishers produce a wide variety of article types, many of which might be considered a [[NewsArticle]] but not a [[ReportageNewsArticle]]. For example, opinion pieces, reviews, analysis, sponsored or satirical articles, or articles that combine several of these elements. The [[ReportageNewsArticle]] type is based on …

terms.label: ReportedDoseSchedule
terms.comment: A patient-reported or observed dosing schedule for a drug or supplement.

terms.label: ResearchOrganization
terms.comment: A Research Organization (e.g. scientific institute, research company).

terms.label: ResearchProject
terms.comment: A Research project.

terms.label: Researcher
terms.comment: Researchers.

terms.label: Reservation
terms.comment: Describes a reservation for travel, dining or an event. Some reservations require tickets. \n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, restaurant reservations, flights, or rental cars, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: ReservationPackage
terms.comment: A group of multiple reservations with common values for all sub-reservations.

terms.label: ReservationStatusType
terms.comment: Enumerated status values for Reservation.

terms.label: ReserveAction
terms.comment:
Reserving a concrete object.

Related actions:

* [[ScheduleAction]]: Unlike ScheduleAction, ReserveAction reserves concrete objects (e.g. a table, a hotel) towards a time slot / spatial allocation.

terms.label: Reservoir
terms.comment: A reservoir of water, typically an artificially created lake, like the Lake Kariba reservoir.

terms.label: ResetPasswordAction
terms.comment: The action of resetting the password of a device or application.

terms.label: Residence
terms.comment: The place where a person lives.

terms.label: Resort
terms.comment:
A resort is a place used for relaxation or recreation, attracting visitors for holidays or vacations. Resorts are places, towns or sometimes commercial establishments operated by a single company (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resort).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: Restaurant
terms.comment: A restaurant.

terms.label: RestrictedDiet
terms.comment: A diet restricted to certain foods or preparations for cultural, religious, health or lifestyle reasons.

terms.label: ResumeAction
terms.comment: The act of resuming a device or application which was formerly paused (e.g. resume music playback or resume a timer).

terms.label: ReturnAction
terms.comment: The act of returning to the origin that which was previously received (concrete objects) or taken (ownership).

terms.label: ReturnFeesEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates several kinds of policies for product return fees.

terms.label: ReturnLabelSourceEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates several types of return labels for product returns.

terms.label: ReturnMethodEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates several types of product return methods.

terms.label: Review
terms.comment: A review of an item - for example, of a restaurant, movie, or store.

terms.label: ReviewAction
terms.comment: The act of producing a balanced opinion about the object for an audience. An agent reviews an object with participants resulting in a review.

terms.label: ReviewNewsArticle
terms.comment: A [[NewsArticle]] and [[CriticReview]] providing a professional critic's assessment of a service, product, performance, or artistic or literary work.

terms.label: RiverBodyOfWater
terms.comment: A river (for example, the broad majestic Shannon).

terms.label: Role
terms.comment: Represents additional information about a relationship or property. For example a Role can be used to say that a 'member' role linking some SportsTeam to a player occurred during a particular time period. Or that a Person's 'actor' role in a Movie was for some particular characterName. Such properties can be attached to a Role entity, which is then associated with the main entities using ordinary properties like 'member' or 'actor'.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/06/16/int…

terms.label: RoofingContractor
terms.comment: A roofing contractor.

terms.label: Room
terms.comment:
A room is a distinguishable space within a structure, usually separated from other spaces by interior walls (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Room).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: RsvpAction
terms.comment: The act of notifying an event organizer as to whether you expect to attend the event.

terms.label: RsvpResponseType
terms.comment: RsvpResponseType is an enumeration type whose instances represent responding to an RSVP request.

terms.label: RuntimePlatform
terms.comment: Specialized software environment that provides the essential infrastructure, libraries, and services required to execute a program.

terms.label: SaleEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Sales event.

terms.label: SatiricalArticle
terms.comment: An [[Article]] whose content is primarily [[satirical]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satire) in nature, i.e. unlikely to be literally true. A satirical article is sometimes but not necessarily also a [[NewsArticle]]. [[ScholarlyArticle]]s are also sometimes satirized.

terms.label: Schedule
terms.comment: A schedule defines a repeating time period used to describe a regularly occurring [[Event]]. At a minimum a schedule will specify [[repeatFrequency]] which describes the interval between occurrences of the event. Additional information can be provided to specify the schedule more precisely. This includes identifying the day(s) of the week or month when the recurring event will take place, in addition to its start and end time. Schedules may also have start and end dates to indicate when they ar…

terms.label: ScheduleAction
terms.comment:
Scheduling future actions, events, or tasks.

Related actions:

* [[ReserveAction]]: Unlike ReserveAction, ScheduleAction allocates future actions (e.g. an event, a task, etc) towards a time slot / spatial allocation.

terms.label: ScholarlyArticle
terms.comment: A scholarly article.

terms.label: School
terms.comment: A school.

terms.label: SchoolDistrict
terms.comment: A School District is an administrative area for the administration of schools.

terms.label: ScreeningEvent
terms.comment: A screening of a movie or other video.

terms.label: Sculpture
terms.comment: A piece of sculpture.

terms.label: SeaBodyOfWater
terms.comment: A sea (for example, the Caspian sea).

terms.label: SearchAction
terms.comment:
The act of searching for an object.

Related actions:

* [[FindAction]]: SearchAction generally leads to a FindAction, but not necessarily.

terms.label: SearchRescueOrganization
terms.comment: A Search and Rescue organization of some kind.

terms.label: SearchResultsPage
terms.comment: Web page type: Search results page.

terms.label: Season
terms.comment: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

terms.label: Seat
terms.comment: Used to describe a seat, such as a reserved seat in an event reservation.

terms.label: SeekToAction
terms.comment: This is the [[Action]] of navigating to a specific [[startOffset]] timestamp within a [[VideoObject]], typically represented with a URL template structure.

terms.label: SelfStorage
terms.comment: A self-storage facility.

terms.label: SellAction
terms.comment: The act of taking money from a buyer in exchange for goods or services rendered. An agent sells an object, product, or service to a buyer for a price. Reciprocal of BuyAction.

terms.label: SendAction
terms.comment:
The act of physically/electronically dispatching an object for transfer from an origin to a destination. Related actions:

* [[ReceiveAction]]: The reciprocal of SendAction.
* [[GiveAction]]: Unlike GiveAction, SendAction does not imply the transfer of ownership (e.g. I can send you my laptop, but I'm not necessarily giving it to you).

terms.label: SequentialArt
terms.comment: An art forms that use images deployed in a specific order for the purpose of graphic storytelling (i.e., narration of graphic stories) or conveying information. Examples of SequentialArt are Franco-Belgian Bande Dessinée, Comics in the USA and 漫画 (Manga) in Japan.

terms.label: Series
terms.comment: A Series in schema.org is a group of related items, typically but not necessarily of the same kind. See also [[CreativeWorkSeries]], [[EventSeries]].

terms.label: Service
terms.comment: A service provided by an organization, e.g. delivery service, print services, etc.

terms.label: ServiceChannel
terms.comment: A means for accessing a service, e.g. a government office location, web site, or phone number.

terms.label: ServicePeriod
terms.comment: ServicePeriod represents a duration with some constraints about cutoff time and business days. This is used e.g. in shipping for handling times or transit time.

terms.label: ShareAction
terms.comment: The act of distributing content to people for their amusement or edification.

terms.label: SheetMusic
terms.comment: Printed music, as opposed to performed or recorded music.

terms.label: ShippingConditions
terms.comment: ShippingConditions represent a set of constraints and information about the conditions of shipping a product. Such conditions may apply to only a subset of the products being shipped, depending on aspects of the product like weight, size, price, destination, and others. All the specified conditions must be met for this ShippingConditions to apply.

terms.label: ShippingDeliveryTime
terms.comment: ShippingDeliveryTime provides various pieces of information about delivery times for shipping.

terms.label: ShippingRateSettings
terms.comment: A ShippingRateSettings represents re-usable pieces of shipping information. It is designed for publication on an URL that may be referenced via the [[shippingSettingsLink]] property of an [[OfferShippingDetails]]. Several occurrences can be published, distinguished and matched (i.e. identified/referenced) by their different values for [[shippingLabel]].

terms.label: ShippingService
terms.comment: ShippingService represents the criteria used to determine if and how an offer could be shipped to a customer.

terms.label: ShoeStore
terms.comment: A shoe store.

terms.label: ShoppingCenter
terms.comment: A shopping center or mall.

terms.label: ShortStory
terms.comment: Short story or tale. A brief work of literature, usually written in narrative prose.

terms.label: SingleFamilyResidence
terms.comment: Residence type: Single-family home.

terms.label: SiteNavigationElement
terms.comment: A navigation element of the page.

terms.label: SizeGroupEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates common size groups for various product categories.

terms.label: SizeSpecification
terms.comment: Size related properties of a product, typically a size code ([[name]]) and optionally a [[sizeSystem]], [[sizeGroup]], and product measurements ([[hasMeasurement]]). In addition, the intended audience can be defined through [[suggestedAge]], [[suggestedGender]], and suggested body measurements ([[suggestedMeasurement]]).

terms.label: SizeSystemEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates common size systems for different categories of products, for example "EN-13402" or "UK" for wearables or "Imperial" for screws.

terms.label: SkiResort
terms.comment: A ski resort.

terms.label: SocialEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Social event.

terms.label: SocialMediaPosting
terms.comment: A post to a social media platform, including blog posts, tweets, Facebook posts, etc.

terms.label: SoftwareApplication
terms.comment: A software application.

terms.label: SoftwareSourceCode
terms.comment: Computer programming source code. Example: Full (compile ready) solutions, code snippet samples, scripts, templates.

terms.label: SolveMathAction
terms.comment: The action that takes in a math expression and directs users to a page potentially capable of solving/simplifying that expression.

terms.label: SomeProducts
terms.comment: A placeholder for multiple similar products of the same kind.

terms.label: SpeakableSpecification
terms.comment: A SpeakableSpecification indicates (typically via [[xpath]] or [[cssSelector]]) sections of a document that are highlighted as particularly [[speakable]]. Instances of this type are expected to be used primarily as values of the [[speakable]] property.

terms.label: SpecialAnnouncement
terms.comment: A SpecialAnnouncement combines a simple date-stamped textual information update with contextualized Web links and other structured data. It represents an information update made by a locally-oriented organization, for example schools, pharmacies, healthcare providers, community groups, police, local government. For work in progress guidelines on Coronavirus-related markup see [this doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14ikaGCKxo50rRM7nvKSlbUpjyIk2WMQd3IkB1lItlrM/edit#). The motivating scenar…

terms.label: Specialty
terms.comment: Any branch of a field in which people typically develop specific expertise, usually after significant study, time, and effort.

terms.label: SportingGoodsStore
terms.comment: A sporting goods store.

terms.label: SportsActivityLocation
terms.comment: A sports location, such as a playing field.

terms.label: SportsClub
terms.comment: A sports club.

terms.label: SportsEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Sports event.

terms.label: SportsOrganization
terms.comment: Represents the collection of all sports organizations, including sports teams, governing bodies, and sports associations.

terms.label: SportsTeam
terms.comment: Organization: Sports team.

terms.label: SpreadsheetDigitalDocument
terms.comment: A spreadsheet file.

terms.label: StadiumOrArena
terms.comment: A stadium.

terms.label: State
terms.comment: A state or province of a country.

terms.label: Statement
terms.comment: A statement about something, for example a fun or interesting fact. If known, the main entity this statement is about can be indicated using mainEntity. For more formal claims (e.g. in Fact Checking), consider using [[Claim]] instead. Use the [[text]] property to capture the text of the statement.

terms.label: StatisticalPopulation
terms.comment: A StatisticalPopulation is a set of instances of a certain given type that satisfy some set of constraints. The property [[populationType]] is used to specify the type. Any property that can be used on instances of that type can appear on the statistical population. For example, a [[StatisticalPopulation]] representing all [[Person]]s with a [[homeLocation]] of East Podunk California would be described by applying the appropriate [[homeLocation]] and [[populationType]] properties to a [[Statist…

terms.label: StatisticalVariable
terms.comment: [[StatisticalVariable]] represents any type of statistical metric that can be measured at a place and time. The usage pattern for [[StatisticalVariable]] is typically expressed using [[Observation]] with an explicit [[populationType]], which is a type, typically drawn from Schema.org. Each [[StatisticalVariable]] is marked as a [[ConstraintNode]], meaning that some properties (those listed using [[constraintProperty]]) serve in this setting solely to define the statistical variable rather than …

terms.label: StatusEnumeration
terms.comment: Lists or enumerations dealing with status types.

terms.label: SteeringPositionValue
terms.comment: A value indicating a steering position.

terms.label: Store
terms.comment: A retail good store.

terms.label: StructuredValue
terms.comment: Structured values are used when the value of a property has a more complex structure than simply being a textual value or a reference to another thing.

terms.label: SubscribeAction
terms.comment:
The act of forming a personal connection with someone/something (object) unidirectionally/asymmetrically to get updates pushed to.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, SubscribeAction implies that the subscriber acts as a passive agent being constantly/actively pushed for updates.
* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, SubscribeAction implies that the agent is interested in continuing receiving updates from the object.
* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, Subs…

terms.label: Substance
terms.comment: Any matter of defined composition that has discrete existence, whose origin may be biological, mineral or chemical.

terms.label: SubwayStation
terms.comment: A subway station.

terms.label: Suite
terms.comment:
A suite in a hotel or other public accommodation, denotes a class of luxury accommodations, the key feature of which is multiple rooms (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suite_(hotel)).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

terms.label: SuperficialAnatomy
terms.comment: Anatomical features that can be observed by sight (without dissection), including the form and proportions of the human body as well as surface landmarks that correspond to deeper subcutaneous structures. Superficial anatomy plays an important role in sports medicine, phlebotomy, and other medical specialties as underlying anatomical structures can be identified through surface palpation. For example, during back surgery, superficial anatomy can be used to palpate and count vertebrae to find th…

terms.label: SurgicalProcedure
terms.comment: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed for diagnose, or therapeutic purposes.

terms.label: SuspendAction
terms.comment: The act of momentarily pausing a device or application (e.g. pause music playback or pause a timer).

terms.label: Syllabus
terms.comment: A syllabus that describes the material covered in a course, often with several such sections per [[Course]] so that a distinct [[timeRequired]] can be provided for that section of the [[Course]].

terms.label: Synagogue
terms.comment: A synagogue.

terms.label: TVClip
terms.comment: A short TV program or a segment/part of a TV program.

terms.label: TVEpisode
terms.comment: A TV episode which can be part of a series or season.

terms.label: TVSeason
terms.comment: Season dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

terms.label: TVSeries
terms.comment: CreativeWorkSeries dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

terms.label: Table
terms.comment: A table on a Web page.

terms.label: TakeAction
terms.comment:
The act of gaining ownership of an object from an origin. Reciprocal of GiveAction.

Related actions:

* [[GiveAction]]: The reciprocal of TakeAction.
* [[ReceiveAction]]: Unlike ReceiveAction, TakeAction implies that ownership has been transferred.

terms.label: TattooParlor
terms.comment: A tattoo parlor.

terms.label: Taxi
terms.comment: A taxi.

terms.label: TaxiReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for a taxi.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: TaxiService
terms.comment: A service for a vehicle for hire with a driver for local travel. Fares are usually calculated based on distance traveled.

terms.label: TaxiStand
terms.comment: A taxi stand.

terms.label: Taxon
terms.comment: A set of organisms asserted to represent a natural cohesive biological unit.

terms.label: TechArticle
terms.comment: A technical article - Example: How-to (task) topics, step-by-step, procedural troubleshooting, specifications, etc.

terms.label: TelevisionChannel
terms.comment: A unique instance of a television BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

terms.label: TelevisionStation
terms.comment: A television station.

terms.label: TennisComplex
terms.comment: A tennis complex.

terms.label: Text
terms.comment: Data type: Text.

terms.label: TextDigitalDocument
terms.comment: A file composed primarily of text.

terms.label: TextObject
terms.comment: A text file. The text can be unformatted or contain markup, html, etc.

terms.label: TheaterEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Theater performance.

terms.label: TheaterGroup
terms.comment: A theater group or company, for example, the Royal Shakespeare Company or Druid Theatre.

terms.label: TherapeuticProcedure
terms.comment: A medical procedure intended primarily for therapeutic purposes, aimed at improving a health condition.

terms.label: Thesis
terms.comment: A thesis or dissertation document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification.

terms.label: Thing
terms.comment: The most generic type of item.

terms.label: Ticket
terms.comment: Used to describe a ticket to an event, a flight, a bus ride, etc.

terms.label: TieAction
terms.comment: The act of reaching a draw in a competitive activity.

terms.label: TierBenefitEnumeration
terms.comment: An enumeration of possible benefits as part of a loyalty (members) program.

terms.label: Time
terms.comment: A point in time recurring on multiple days in the form hh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see [XML schema for details](http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#time)).

terms.label: TipAction
terms.comment: The act of giving money voluntarily to a beneficiary in recognition of services rendered.

terms.label: TireShop
terms.comment: A tire shop.

terms.label: TouristAttraction
terms.comment: A tourist attraction. In principle any Thing can be a [[TouristAttraction]], from a [[Mountain]] and [[LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings]] to a [[LocalBusiness]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristAttraction]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist attraction properties to any other type. (See examples below)

terms.label: TouristDestination
terms.comment: A tourist destination. In principle any [[Place]] can be a [[TouristDestination]] from a [[City]], Region or [[Country]] to an [[AmusementPark]] or [[Hotel]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristDestination]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist relevant properties to any other [[Place]]. A [[TouristDestination]] is defined as a [[Place]] that contains, or is colocated with, one or more [[TouristAttraction]]s, often linked by a similar theme or interes…

terms.label: TouristInformationCenter
terms.comment: A tourist information center.

terms.label: TouristTrip
terms.comment: A tourist trip. A created itinerary of visits to one or more places of interest ([[TouristAttraction]]/[[TouristDestination]]) often linked by a similar theme, geographic area, or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines tourism trip as the Trip taken by visitors. (See examples below.)

terms.label: ToyStore
terms.comment: A toy store.

terms.label: TrackAction
terms.comment:
An agent tracks an object for updates.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimates objects.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimate objects.

terms.label: TradeAction
terms.comment: The act of participating in an exchange of goods and services for monetary compensation. An agent trades an object, product or service with a participant in exchange for a one time or periodic payment.

terms.label: TrainReservation
terms.comment: A reservation for train travel.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

terms.label: TrainStation
terms.comment: A train station.

terms.label: TrainTrip
terms.comment: A trip on a commercial train line.

terms.label: TransferAction
terms.comment: The act of transferring/moving (abstract or concrete) animate or inanimate objects from one place to another.

terms.label: TravelAction
terms.comment: The act of traveling from a fromLocation to a destination by a specified mode of transport, optionally with participants.

terms.label: TravelAgency
terms.comment: A travel agency.

terms.label: TreatmentIndication
terms.comment: An indication for treating an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

terms.label: Trip
terms.comment: A trip or journey. An itinerary of visits to one or more places.

terms.label: TypeAndQuantityNode
terms.comment: A structured value indicating the quantity, unit of measurement, and business function of goods included in a bundle offer.

terms.label: UKNonprofitType
terms.comment: UKNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the United Kingdom.

terms.label: URL
terms.comment: Data type: URL.

terms.label: USNonprofitType
terms.comment: USNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from the United States.

terms.label: UnRegisterAction
terms.comment:
The act of un-registering from a service.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: antonym of UnRegisterAction.
* [[LeaveAction]]: Unlike LeaveAction, UnRegisterAction implies that you are unregistering from a service you were previously registered, rather than leaving a team/group of people.

terms.label: UnitPriceSpecification
terms.comment: The price asked for a given offer by the respective organization or person.

terms.label: UpdateAction
terms.comment: The act of managing by changing/editing the state of the object.

terms.label: UseAction
terms.comment: The act of applying an object to its intended purpose.

terms.label: UserBlocks
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserCheckins
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserComments
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserDownloads
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserInteraction
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserLikes
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserPageVisits
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserPlays
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserPlusOnes
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: UserReview
terms.comment: A review created by an end-user (e.g. consumer, purchaser, attendee etc.), in contrast with [[CriticReview]].

terms.label: UserTweets
terms.comment: UserInteraction and its subtypes is an old way of talking about users interacting with pages. It is generally better to use [[Action]]-based vocabulary, alongside types such as [[Comment]].

terms.label: VacationRental
terms.comment: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.

terms.label: Vehicle
terms.comment: A vehicle is a device that is designed or used to transport people or cargo over land, water, air, or through space.

terms.label: Vein
terms.comment: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood to the heart.

terms.label: Vessel
terms.comment: A component of the human body circulatory system comprised of an intricate network of hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the entire body.

terms.label: VeterinaryCare
terms.comment: A vet's office.

terms.label: VideoGallery
terms.comment: Web page type: Video gallery page.

terms.label: VideoGame
terms.comment: A video game is an electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.

terms.label: VideoGameClip
terms.comment: A short segment/part of a video game.

terms.label: VideoGameSeries
terms.comment: A video game series.

terms.label: VideoObject
terms.comment: A video file.

terms.label: VideoObjectSnapshot
terms.comment: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of a [[VideoObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

terms.label: ViewAction
terms.comment: The act of consuming static visual content.

terms.label: VirtualLocation
terms.comment: An online or virtual location for attending events. For example, one may attend an online seminar or educational event. While a virtual location may be used as the location of an event, virtual locations should not be confused with physical locations in the real world.

terms.label: VisualArtsEvent
terms.comment: Event type: Visual arts event.

terms.label: VisualArtwork
terms.comment: A work of art that is primarily visual in character.

terms.label: VitalSign
terms.comment: Vital signs are measures of various physiological functions in order to assess the most basic body functions.

terms.label: Volcano
terms.comment: A volcano, like Fujisan.

terms.label: VoteAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a preference from a fixed/finite/structured set of choices/options.

terms.label: WPAdBlock
terms.comment: An advertising section of the page.

terms.label: WPFooter
terms.comment: The footer section of the page.

terms.label: WPHeader
terms.comment: The header section of the page.

terms.label: WPSideBar
terms.comment: A sidebar section of the page.

terms.label: WantAction
terms.comment: The act of expressing a desire about the object. An agent wants an object.

terms.label: WarrantyPromise
terms.comment: A structured value representing the duration and scope of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

terms.label: WarrantyScope
terms.comment:
A range of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Labor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-PickUp

terms.label: WatchAction
terms.comment: The act of consuming dynamic/moving visual content.

terms.label: Waterfall
terms.comment: A waterfall, like Niagara.

terms.label: WearAction
terms.comment: The act of dressing oneself in clothing.

terms.label: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates common types of measurement for wearables products.

terms.label: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates common size groups (also known as "size types") for wearable products.

terms.label: WearableSizeSystemEnumeration
terms.comment: Enumerates common size systems specific for wearable products.

terms.label: WebAPI
terms.comment: An application programming interface accessible over Web/Internet technologies.

terms.label: WebApplication
terms.comment: Web applications.

terms.label: WebContent
terms.comment: WebContent is a type representing all [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] content. It is sometimes the case that detailed distinctions between Web pages, sites and their parts are not always important or obvious. The [[WebContent]] type makes it easier to describe Web-addressable content without requiring such distinctions to always be stated. (The intent is that the existing types [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] will eventually be declared as subtypes of [[WebConten…

terms.label: WebPage
terms.comment: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.

terms.label: WebPageElement
terms.comment: A web page element, like a table or an image.

terms.label: WebSite
terms.comment: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain and accessible via URLs.

terms.label: WholesaleStore
terms.comment: A wholesale store.

terms.label: WinAction
terms.comment: The act of achieving victory in a competitive activity.

terms.label: Winery
terms.comment: A winery.

terms.label: WorkBasedProgram
terms.comment: A program with both an educational and employment component. Typically based at a workplace and structured around work-based learning, with the aim of instilling competencies related to an occupation. WorkBasedProgram is used to distinguish programs such as apprenticeships from school, college or other classroom based educational programs.

terms.label: WorkersUnion
terms.comment: A Workers Union (also known as a Labor Union, Labour Union, or Trade Union) is an organization that promotes the interests of its worker members by collectively bargaining with management, organizing, and political lobbying.

terms.label: WriteAction
terms.comment: The act of authoring written creative content.

terms.label: XPathType
terms.comment: Text representing an XPath (typically but not necessarily version 1.0).

terms.label: Zoo
terms.comment: A zoo.

terms.label: about
terms.comment: The subject matter of an object.
