terms.label: abridged
terms.comment: Indicates whether the book is an abridged edition.

terms.label: abstract
terms.comment: An abstract is a short description that summarizes a [[CreativeWork]].

terms.label: accelerationTime
terms.comment:
The time needed to accelerate the vehicle from a given start velocity to a given target velocity.

Typical unit code(s): SEC for seconds

* Note: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for seconds/0..100 km/h or seconds/0..60 mph. Simply use "SEC" for seconds and indicate the velocities in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]], or use [[valueReference]] with a [[QuantitativeValue]] of 0..60 mph or 0..100 km/h to specify the reference speeds.

terms.label: acceptedAnswer
terms.comment: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.

terms.label: acceptedOffer
terms.comment: The offer(s) -- e.g., product, quantity and price combinations -- included in the order.

terms.label: acceptedPaymentMethod
terms.comment: The payment method(s) that are accepted in general by an organization, or for some specific demand or offer.

terms.label: acceptsReservations
terms.comment: Indicates whether a FoodEstablishment accepts reservations. Values can be Boolean, an URL at which reservations can be made or (for backwards compatibility) the strings ```Yes``` or ```No```.

terms.label: accessCode
terms.comment: Password, PIN, or access code needed for delivery (e.g. from a locker).

terms.label: accessMode
terms.comment: The human sensory perceptual system or cognitive faculty through which a person may process or perceive the intellectual content of a resource, not including any adaptations of the content (e.g., text alternatives for images). Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessMode-vocabulary).

terms.label: accessModeSufficient
terms.comment: A list of single or combined access modes that are sufficient to understand all the intellectual content of a resource, including any adaptations. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessModeSufficient-vocabulary).

terms.label: accessibilityAPI
terms.comment: Indicates that the resource is compatible with the referenced accessibility API. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityAPI-vocabulary).

terms.label: accessibilityControl
terms.comment: Identifies input methods that are sufficient to fully control the described resource. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityControl-vocabulary).

terms.label: accessibilityFeature
terms.comment: Content features of the resource, such as accessible media, alternatives and supported enhancements for accessibility. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityFeature-vocabulary).

terms.label: accessibilityHazard
terms.comment: A characteristic of the described resource that is physiologically dangerous to some users. Related to WCAG 2.0 guideline 2.3. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessibilityHazard-vocabulary).

terms.label: accessibilitySummary
terms.comment: A human-readable summary of specific accessibility features or deficiencies, consistent with the other accessibility metadata but expressing subtleties such as "short descriptions are present but long descriptions will be needed for non-visual users" or "short descriptions are present and no long descriptions are needed".

terms.label: accommodationCategory
terms.comment: Category of an [[Accommodation]], following real estate conventions, e.g. RESO (see [PropertySubType](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/PropertySubType+Field), and [PropertyType](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/PropertyType+Field) fields for suggested values).

terms.label: accommodationFloorPlan
terms.comment: A floorplan of some [[Accommodation]].

terms.label: accountId
terms.comment: The identifier for the account the payment will be applied to.

terms.label: accountMinimumInflow
terms.comment: A minimum amount that has to be paid in every month.

terms.label: accountOverdraftLimit
terms.comment: An overdraft is an extension of credit from a lending institution when an account reaches zero. An overdraft allows the individual to continue withdrawing money even if the account has no funds in it. Basically the bank allows people to borrow a set amount of money.

terms.label: accountablePerson
terms.comment: Specifies the Person that is legally accountable for the CreativeWork.

terms.label: acquireLicensePage
terms.comment: Indicates a page documenting how licenses can be purchased or otherwise acquired, for the current item.

terms.label: acquiredFrom
terms.comment: The organization or person from which the product was acquired.

terms.label: acrissCode
terms.comment: The ACRISS Car Classification Code is a code used by many car rental companies, for classifying vehicles. ACRISS stands for Association of Car Rental Industry Systems and Standards.

terms.label: actionAccessibilityRequirement
terms.comment: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action. If more than one value is specified, fulfilling one set of requirements will allow the Action to be performed.

terms.label: actionApplication
terms.comment: An application that can complete the request.

terms.label: actionOption
terms.comment: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

terms.label: actionPlatform
terms.comment: The high level platform(s) where the Action can be performed for the given URL. To specify a specific application or operating system instance, use actionApplication.

terms.label: actionProcess
terms.comment: Description of the process by which the action was performed.

terms.label: actionStatus
terms.comment: Indicates the current disposition of the Action.

terms.label: actionableFeedbackPolicy
terms.comment: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement about public engagement activities (for news media, the newsroom’s), including involving the public - digitally or otherwise -- in coverage decisions, reporting and activities after publication.

terms.label: activeIngredient
terms.comment: An active ingredient, typically chemical compounds and/or biologic substances.

terms.label: activityDuration
terms.comment: Length of time to engage in the activity.

terms.label: activityFrequency
terms.comment: How often one should engage in the activity.

terms.label: actor
terms.comment: An actor (individual or a group), e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc., or in an event. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

terms.label: actors
terms.comment: An actor, e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

terms.label: addOn
terms.comment: An additional offer that can only be obtained in combination with the first base offer (e.g. supplements and extensions that are available for a surcharge).

terms.label: additionalName
terms.comment: An additional name for a Person, can be used for a middle name.

terms.label: additionalNumberOfGuests
terms.comment: If responding yes, the number of guests who will attend in addition to the invitee.

terms.label: additionalProperty
terms.comment: A property-value pair representing an additional characteristic of the entity, e.g. a product feature or another characteristic for which there is no matching property in schema.org.\n\nNote: Publishers should be aware that applications designed to use specific schema.org properties (e.g. http://schema.org/width, http://schema.org/color, http://schema.org/gtin13, ...) will typically expect such data to be provided using those properties, rather than using the generic property/value mechanism.

terms.label: additionalType
terms.comment: An additional type for the item, typically used for adding more specific types from external vocabularies in microdata syntax. This is a relationship between something and a class that the thing is in. Typically the value is a URI-identified RDF class, and in this case corresponds to the use of rdf:type in RDF. Text values can be used sparingly, for cases where useful information can be added without their being an appropriate schema to reference. In the case of text values, the class label sho…

terms.label: additionalVariable
terms.comment: Any additional component of the exercise prescription that may need to be articulated to the patient. This may include the order of exercises, the number of repetitions of movement, quantitative distance, progressions over time, etc.

terms.label: address
terms.comment: Physical address of the item.

terms.label: addressCountry
terms.comment: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

terms.label: addressLocality
terms.comment: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

terms.label: addressRegion
terms.comment: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level [Administrative division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_administrative_divisions_by_country) such as the Province in Italy or Region in Germany.

terms.label: administrationRoute
terms.comment: A route by which this drug may be administered, e.g. 'oral'.

terms.label: advanceBookingRequirement
terms.comment: The amount of time that is required between accepting the offer and the actual usage of the resource or service.

terms.label: adverseOutcome
terms.comment: A possible complication and/or side effect of this therapy. If it is known that an adverse outcome is serious (resulting in death, disability, or permanent damage; requiring hospitalization; or otherwise life-threatening or requiring immediate medical attention), tag it as a seriousAdverseOutcome instead.

terms.label: affectedBy
terms.comment: Drugs that affect the test's results.

terms.label: affiliation
terms.comment: An organization that this person is affiliated with. For example, a school/university, a club, or a team.

terms.label: afterMedia
terms.comment: A media object representing the circumstances after performing this direction.

terms.label: agent
terms.comment: The direct performer or driver of the action (animate or inanimate). E.g. *John* wrote a book.

terms.label: agentInteractionStatistic
terms.comment: The number of completed interactions for this entity, in a particular role (the 'agent'), in a particular action (indicated in the statistic), and in a particular context (i.e. interactionService).

terms.label: aggregateElement
terms.comment: Indicates a prototype of the elements in the list that is used to hold aggregate information (ratings, offers, etc.).

terms.label: aggregateRating
terms.comment: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

terms.label: aircraft
terms.comment: The kind of aircraft (e.g., "Boeing 747").

terms.label: album
terms.comment: A music album.

terms.label: albumProductionType
terms.comment: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

terms.label: albumRelease
terms.comment: A release of this album.

terms.label: albumReleaseType
terms.comment: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

terms.label: albums
terms.comment: A collection of music albums.

terms.label: alcoholWarning
terms.comment: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of alcohol while taking this drug.

terms.label: algorithm
terms.comment: The algorithm or rules to follow to compute the score.

terms.label: alignmentType
terms.comment: A category of alignment between the learning resource and the framework node. Recommended values include: 'requires', 'textComplexity', 'readingLevel', and 'educationalSubject'.

terms.label: alternateName
terms.comment: An alias for the item.

terms.label: alternativeHeadline
terms.comment: A secondary title of the CreativeWork.

terms.label: alternativeOf
terms.comment: Another gene which is a variation of this one.

terms.label: alumni
terms.comment: Alumni of an organization.

terms.label: alumniOf
terms.comment: An organization that the person is an alumni of.

terms.label: amenityFeature
terms.comment: An amenity feature (e.g. a characteristic or service) of the Accommodation. This generic property does not make a statement about whether the feature is included in an offer for the main accommodation or available at extra costs.

terms.label: amount
terms.comment: The amount of money.

terms.label: amountOfThisGood
terms.comment: The quantity of the goods included in the offer.

terms.label: announcementLocation
terms.comment: Indicates a specific [[CivicStructure]] or [[LocalBusiness]] associated with the SpecialAnnouncement. For example, a specific testing facility or business with special opening hours. For a larger geographic region like a quarantine of an entire region, use [[spatialCoverage]].

terms.label: annualPercentageRate
terms.comment: The annual rate that is charged for borrowing (or made by investing), expressed as a single percentage number that represents the actual yearly cost of funds over the term of a loan. This includes any fees or additional costs associated with the transaction.

terms.label: answerCount
terms.comment: The number of answers this question has received.

terms.label: answerExplanation
terms.comment: A step-by-step or full explanation about Answer. Can outline how this Answer was achieved or contain more broad clarification or statement about it.

terms.label: antagonist
terms.comment: The muscle whose action counteracts the specified muscle.

terms.label: appearance
terms.comment: Indicates an occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

terms.label: applicableCountry
terms.comment: A country where a particular merchant return policy applies to, for example the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

terms.label: applicableLocation
terms.comment: The location in which the status applies.

terms.label: applicantLocationRequirements
terms.comment: The location(s) applicants can apply from. This is usually used for telecommuting jobs where the applicant does not need to be in a physical office. Note: This should not be used for citizenship or work visa requirements.

terms.label: application
terms.comment: An application that can complete the request.

terms.label: applicationCategory
terms.comment: Type of software application, e.g. 'Game, Multimedia'.

terms.label: applicationContact
terms.comment: Contact details for further information relevant to this job posting.

terms.label: applicationDeadline
terms.comment: The date on which the program stops collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle. Flexible application deadlines (for example, a program with rolling admissions) can be described in a textual string, rather than as a DateTime.

terms.label: applicationStartDate
terms.comment: The date at which the program begins collecting applications for the next enrollment cycle.

terms.label: applicationSubCategory
terms.comment: Subcategory of the application, e.g. 'Arcade Game'.

terms.label: applicationSuite
terms.comment: The name of the application suite to which the application belongs (e.g. Excel belongs to Office).

terms.label: appliesToDeliveryMethod
terms.comment: The delivery method(s) to which the delivery charge or payment charge specification applies.

terms.label: appliesToPaymentMethod
terms.comment: The payment method(s) to which the payment charge specification applies.

terms.label: archiveHeld
terms.comment: Collection, [fonds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fonds), or item held, kept or maintained by an [[ArchiveOrganization]].

terms.label: archivedAt
terms.comment: Indicates a page or other link involved in archival of a [[CreativeWork]]. In the case of [[MediaReview]], the items in a [[MediaReviewItem]] may often become inaccessible, but be archived by archival, journalistic, activist, or law enforcement organizations. In such cases, the referenced page may not directly publish the content.

terms.label: area
terms.comment: The area within which users can expect to reach the broadcast service.

terms.label: areaServed
terms.comment: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.

terms.label: arrivalAirport
terms.comment: The airport where the flight terminates.

terms.label: arrivalBoatTerminal
terms.comment: The terminal or port from which the boat arrives.

terms.label: arrivalBusStop
terms.comment: The stop or station from which the bus arrives.

terms.label: arrivalGate
terms.comment: Identifier of the flight's arrival gate.

terms.label: arrivalPlatform
terms.comment: The platform where the train arrives.

terms.label: arrivalStation
terms.comment: The station where the train trip ends.

terms.label: arrivalTerminal
terms.comment: Identifier of the flight's arrival terminal.

terms.label: arrivalTime
terms.comment: The expected arrival time.

terms.label: artEdition
terms.comment: The number of copies when multiple copies of a piece of artwork are produced - e.g. for a limited edition of 20 prints, 'artEdition' refers to the total number of copies (in this example "20").

terms.label: artMedium
terms.comment: The material used. (E.g. Oil, Watercolour, Acrylic, Linoprint, Marble, Cyanotype, Digital, Lithograph, DryPoint, Intaglio, Pastel, Woodcut, Pencil, Mixed Media, etc.)

terms.label: arterialBranch
terms.comment: The branches that comprise the arterial structure.

terms.label: artform
terms.comment: e.g. Painting, Drawing, Sculpture, Print, Photograph, Assemblage, Collage, etc.

terms.label: articleBody
terms.comment: The actual body of the article.

terms.label: articleSection
terms.comment: Articles may belong to one or more 'sections' in a magazine or newspaper, such as Sports, Lifestyle, etc.

terms.label: artist
terms.comment: The primary artist for a work in a medium other than pencils or digital line art--for example, if the primary artwork is done in watercolors or digital paints.

terms.label: artworkSurface
terms.comment: The supporting materials for the artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

terms.label: asin
terms.comment: An Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) is a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.com and its partners for product identification within the Amazon organization (summary from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Standard_Identification_Number)'s article). Note also that this is a definition for how to include ASINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of ASINs in general - see documentation from Amazon for authoritative details. ASINs are most c…

terms.label: aspect
terms.comment: An aspect of medical practice that is considered on the page, such as 'diagnosis', 'treatment', 'causes', 'prognosis', 'etiology', 'epidemiology', etc.

terms.label: assembly
terms.comment: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

terms.label: assemblyVersion
terms.comment: Associated product/technology version. E.g., .NET Framework 4.5.

terms.label: assesses
terms.comment: The item being described is intended to assess the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

terms.label: associatedAnatomy
terms.comment: The anatomy of the underlying organ system or structures associated with this entity.

terms.label: associatedArticle
terms.comment: A NewsArticle associated with the Media Object.

terms.label: associatedClaimReview
terms.comment: An associated [[ClaimReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

terms.label: associatedDisease
terms.comment: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.

terms.label: associatedMedia
terms.comment: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for encoding.

terms.label: associatedMediaReview
terms.comment: An associated [[MediaReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

terms.label: associatedPathophysiology
terms.comment: If applicable, a description of the pathophysiology associated with the anatomical system, including potential abnormal changes in the mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions of the system.

terms.label: associatedReview
terms.comment: An associated [[Review]].

terms.label: athlete
terms.comment: A person that acts as performing member of a sports team; a player as opposed to a coach.

terms.label: attendee
terms.comment: A person or organization attending the event.

terms.label: attendees
terms.comment: A person attending the event.

terms.label: audience
terms.comment: An intended audience, i.e. a group for whom something was created.

terms.label: audienceType
terms.comment: The target group associated with a given audience (e.g. veterans, car owners, musicians, etc.).

terms.label: audio
terms.comment: An embedded audio object.

terms.label: auditDate
terms.comment: Date when a certification was last audited. See also [gs1:certificationAuditDate](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationAuditDate).

terms.label: authenticator
terms.comment: The Organization responsible for authenticating the user's subscription. For example, many media apps require a cable/satellite provider to authenticate your subscription before playing media.

terms.label: author
terms.comment: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

terms.label: authorizedRepresentative
terms.comment: An organization or person officially appointed to act on behalf of the manufacturer in a specific region or context.

terms.label: availability
terms.comment: The availability of this item—for example In stock, Out of stock, Pre-order, etc.

terms.label: availabilityEnds
terms.comment: The end of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

terms.label: availabilityStarts
terms.comment: The beginning of the availability of the product or service included in the offer.

terms.label: availableAtOrFrom
terms.comment: The place(s) from which the offer can be obtained (e.g. store locations).

terms.label: availableChannel
terms.comment: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.).

terms.label: availableDeliveryMethod
terms.comment: The delivery method(s) available for this offer.

terms.label: availableFrom
terms.comment: When the item is available for pickup from the store, locker, etc.

terms.label: availableIn
terms.comment: The location in which the strength is available.

terms.label: availableLanguage
terms.comment: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].

terms.label: availableOnDevice
terms.comment: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

terms.label: availableService
terms.comment: A medical service available from this provider.

terms.label: availableStrength
terms.comment: An available dosage strength for the drug.

terms.label: availableTest
terms.comment: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by this lab.

terms.label: availableThrough
terms.comment: After this date, the item will no longer be available for pickup.

terms.label: award
terms.comment: An award won by or for this item.

terms.label: awards
terms.comment: Awards won by or for this item.

terms.label: awayTeam
terms.comment: The away team in a sports event.

terms.label: backstory
terms.comment: For an [[Article]], typically a [[NewsArticle]], the backstory property provides a textual summary giving a brief explanation of why and how an article was created. In a journalistic setting this could include information about reporting process, methods, interviews, data sources, etc.

terms.label: bankAccountType
terms.comment: The type of a bank account.

terms.label: baseSalary
terms.comment: The base salary of the job or of an employee in an EmployeeRole.

terms.label: bccRecipient
terms.comment: A sub property of recipient. The recipient blind copied on a message.

terms.label: bed
terms.comment: The type of bed or beds included in the accommodation. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you use bed directly with a text. If you want to indicate the quantity of a certain kind of bed, use an instance of BedDetails. For more detailed information, use the amenityFeature property.

terms.label: beforeMedia
terms.comment: A media object representing the circumstances before performing this direction.

terms.label: beneficiaryBank
terms.comment: A bank or bank’s branch, financial institution or international financial institution operating the beneficiary’s bank account or releasing funds for the beneficiary.

terms.label: benefits
terms.comment: Description of benefits associated with the job.

terms.label: benefitsSummaryUrl
terms.comment: The URL that goes directly to the summary of benefits and coverage for the specific standard plan or plan variation.

terms.label: bestRating
terms.comment: The highest value allowed in this rating system.

terms.label: billingAddress
terms.comment: The billing address for the order.

terms.label: billingDuration
terms.comment: Specifies for how long this price (or price component) will be billed. Can be used, for example, to model the contractual duration of a subscription or payment plan. Type can be either a Duration or a Number (in which case the unit of measurement, for example month, is specified by the unitCode property).

terms.label: billingIncrement
terms.comment: This property specifies the minimal quantity and rounding increment that will be the basis for the billing. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

terms.label: billingPeriod
terms.comment: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

terms.label: billingStart
terms.comment: Specifies after how much time this price (or price component) becomes valid and billing starts. Can be used, for example, to model a price increase after the first year of a subscription. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

terms.label: bioChemInteraction
terms.comment: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

terms.label: bioChemSimilarity
terms.comment: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

terms.label: biologicalRole
terms.comment: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

terms.label: biomechnicalClass
terms.comment: The biomechanical properties of the bone.

terms.label: birthDate
terms.comment: Date of birth.

terms.label: birthPlace
terms.comment: The place where the person was born.

terms.label: bitrate
terms.comment: The bitrate of the media object.

terms.label: blogPost
terms.comment: A posting that is part of this blog.

terms.label: blogPosts
terms.comment: Indicates a post that is part of a [[Blog]]. Note that historically, what we term a "Blog" was once known as a "weblog", and that what we term a "BlogPosting" is now often colloquially referred to as a "blog".

terms.label: bloodSupply
terms.comment: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.

terms.label: boardingGroup
terms.comment: The airline-specific indicator of boarding order / preference.

terms.label: boardingPolicy
terms.comment: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).

terms.label: bodyLocation
terms.comment: Location in the body of the anatomical structure.

terms.label: bodyType
terms.comment: Indicates the design and body style of the vehicle (e.g. station wagon, hatchback, etc.).

terms.label: bookEdition
terms.comment: The edition of the book.

terms.label: bookFormat
terms.comment: The format of the book.

terms.label: bookingAgent
terms.comment: 'bookingAgent' is an out-dated term indicating a 'broker' that serves as a booking agent.

terms.label: bookingTime
terms.comment: The date and time the reservation was booked.

terms.label: borrower
terms.comment: A sub property of participant. The person that borrows the object being lent.

terms.label: box
terms.comment: A box is the area enclosed by the rectangle formed by two points. The first point is the lower corner, the second point is the upper corner. A box is expressed as two points separated by a space character.

terms.label: branch
terms.comment: The branches that delineate from the nerve bundle. Not to be confused with [[branchOf]].

terms.label: branchCode
terms.comment: A short textual code (also called "store code") that uniquely identifies a place of business. The code is typically assigned by the parentOrganization and used in structured URLs.\n\nFor example, in the URL http://www.starbucks.co.uk/store-locator/etc/detail/3047 the code "3047" is a branchCode for a particular branch.

terms.label: branchOf
terms.comment: The larger organization that this local business is a branch of, if any. Not to be confused with (anatomical) [[branch]].

terms.label: brand
terms.comment: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

terms.label: breadcrumb
terms.comment: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

terms.label: breastfeedingWarning
terms.comment: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.

terms.label: broadcastAffiliateOf
terms.comment: The media network(s) whose content is broadcast on this station.

terms.label: broadcastChannelId
terms.comment: The unique address by which the BroadcastService can be identified in a provider lineup. In US, this is typically a number.

terms.label: broadcastDisplayName
terms.comment: The name displayed in the channel guide. For many US affiliates, it is the network name.

terms.label: broadcastFrequency
terms.comment: The frequency used for over-the-air broadcasts. Numeric values or simple ranges, e.g. 87-99. In addition a shortcut idiom is supported for frequencies of AM and FM radio channels, e.g. "87 FM".

terms.label: broadcastFrequencyValue
terms.comment: The frequency in MHz for a particular broadcast.

terms.label: broadcastOfEvent
terms.comment: The event being broadcast such as a sporting event or awards ceremony.

terms.label: broadcastServiceTier
terms.comment: The type of service required to have access to the channel (e.g. Standard or Premium).

terms.label: broadcastSignalModulation
terms.comment: The modulation (e.g. FM, AM, etc) used by a particular broadcast service.

terms.label: broadcastSubChannel
terms.comment: The subchannel used for the broadcast.

terms.label: broadcastTimezone
terms.comment: The timezone in [ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) for which the service bases its broadcasts.

terms.label: broadcaster
terms.comment: The organization owning or operating the broadcast service.

terms.label: broker
terms.comment: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller. In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange. If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

terms.label: browserRequirements
terms.comment: Specifies browser requirements in human-readable text. For example, 'requires HTML5 support'.

terms.label: busName
terms.comment: The name of the bus (e.g. Bolt Express).

terms.label: busNumber
terms.comment: The unique identifier for the bus.

terms.label: businessDays
terms.comment: Days of the week when the merchant typically operates, indicated via opening hours markup.

terms.label: businessFunction
terms.comment: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

terms.label: buyer
terms.comment: A sub property of participant. The participant/person/organization that bought the object.

terms.label: byArtist
terms.comment: The artist that performed this album or recording.

terms.label: byDay
terms.comment: Defines the day(s) of the week on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. May be specified using either [[DayOfWeek]], or alternatively [[Text]] conforming to iCal's syntax for byDay recurrence rules.

terms.label: byMonth
terms.comment: Defines the month(s) of the year on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-12. January is 1.

terms.label: byMonthDay
terms.comment: Defines the day(s) of the month on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-31.

terms.label: byMonthWeek
terms.comment: Defines the week(s) of the month on which a recurring Event takes place. Specified as an Integer between 1-5. For clarity, byMonthWeek is best used in conjunction with byDay to indicate concepts like the first and third Mondays of a month.

terms.label: callSign
terms.comment: A [callsign](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_sign), as used in broadcasting and radio communications to identify people, radio and TV stations, or vehicles.

terms.label: calories
terms.comment: The number of calories.

terms.label: candidate
terms.comment: A sub property of object. The candidate subject of this action.

terms.label: caption
terms.comment: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

terms.label: carbohydrateContent
terms.comment: The number of grams of carbohydrates.

terms.label: cargoVolume
terms.comment:
The available volume for cargo or luggage. For automobiles, this is usually the trunk volume.

Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet

Note: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: carrier
terms.comment: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.

terms.label: carrierRequirements
terms.comment: Specifies specific carrier(s) requirements for the application (e.g. an application may only work on a specific carrier network).

terms.label: cashBack
terms.comment: A cardholder benefit that pays the cardholder a small percentage of their net expenditures.

terms.label: catalog
terms.comment: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

terms.label: catalogNumber
terms.comment: The catalog number for the release.

terms.label: category
terms.comment: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

terms.label: cause
terms.comment: The cause of a medical condition.

terms.label: causeOf
terms.comment: The condition, complication, symptom, sign, etc. caused.

terms.label: ccRecipient
terms.comment: A sub property of recipient. The recipient copied on a message.

terms.label: certificationIdentification
terms.comment: Identifier of a certification instance (as registered with an independent certification body). Typically this identifier can be used to consult and verify the certification instance. See also [gs1:certificationIdentification](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationIdentification).

terms.label: certificationRating
terms.comment: Rating of a certification instance (as defined by an independent certification body). Typically this rating can be used to rate the level to which the requirements of the certification instance are fulfilled. See also [gs1:certificationValue](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationValue).

terms.label: certificationStatus
terms.comment: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

terms.label: character
terms.comment: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

terms.label: characterAttribute
terms.comment: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

terms.label: characterName
terms.comment: The name of a character played in some acting or performing role, i.e. in a PerformanceRole.

terms.label: cheatCode
terms.comment: Cheat codes to the game.

terms.label: checkinTime
terms.comment: The earliest someone may check into a lodging establishment.

terms.label: checkoutPageURLTemplate
terms.comment: A URL template (RFC 6570) for a checkout page for an offer. This approach allows merchants to specify a URL for online checkout of the offered product, by interpolating parameters such as the logged in user ID, product ID, quantity, discount code etc. Parameter naming and standardization are not specified here.

terms.label: checkoutTime
terms.comment: The latest someone may check out of a lodging establishment.

terms.label: chemicalComposition
terms.comment: The chemical composition describes the identity and relative ratio of the chemical elements that make up the substance.

terms.label: chemicalRole
terms.comment: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.

terms.label: childMaxAge
terms.comment: Maximal age of the child.

terms.label: childMinAge
terms.comment: Minimal age of the child.

terms.label: childTaxon
terms.comment: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.

terms.label: children
terms.comment: A child of the person.

terms.label: cholesterolContent
terms.comment: The number of milligrams of cholesterol.

terms.label: circle
terms.comment: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centered at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

terms.label: citation
terms.comment: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

terms.label: claimInterpreter
terms.comment: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].

terms.label: claimReviewed
terms.comment: A short summary of the specific claims reviewed in a ClaimReview.

terms.label: clincalPharmacology
terms.comment: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

terms.label: clinicalPharmacology
terms.comment: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

terms.label: clipNumber
terms.comment: Position of the clip within an ordered group of clips.

terms.label: closes
terms.comment: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

terms.label: coach
terms.comment: A person that acts in a coaching role for a sports team.

terms.label: code
terms.comment: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

terms.label: codeRepository
terms.comment: Link to the repository where the un-compiled, human readable code and related code is located (SVN, GitHub, CodePlex).

terms.label: codeSampleType
terms.comment: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

terms.label: codeValue
terms.comment: A short textual code that uniquely identifies the value.

terms.label: codingSystem
terms.comment: The coding system, e.g. 'ICD-10'.

terms.label: colleague
terms.comment: A colleague of the person.

terms.label: colleagues
terms.comment: A colleague of the person.

terms.label: collection
terms.comment: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

terms.label: collectionSize
terms.comment: The number of items in the [[Collection]].

terms.label: color
terms.comment: The color of the product.

terms.label: colorSwatch
terms.comment: A color swatch image, visualizing the color of a [[Product]]. Should match the textual description specified in the [[color]] property. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

terms.label: colorist
terms.comment: The individual who adds color to inked drawings.

terms.label: comment
terms.comment: Comments, typically from users.

terms.label: commentCount
terms.comment: The number of comments this CreativeWork (e.g. Article, Question or Answer) has received. This is most applicable to works published in Web sites with commenting system; additional comments may exist elsewhere.

terms.label: commentText
terms.comment: The text of the UserComment.

terms.label: commentTime
terms.comment: The time at which the UserComment was made.

terms.label: companyRegistration
terms.comment: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

terms.label: competencyRequired
terms.comment: Knowledge, skill, ability or personal attribute that must be demonstrated by a person or other entity in order to do something such as earn an Educational Occupational Credential or understand a LearningResource.

terms.label: competitor
terms.comment: A competitor in a sports event.

terms.label: composer
terms.comment: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

terms.label: comprisedOf
terms.comment: Specifying something physically contained by something else. Typically used here for the underlying anatomical structures, such as organs, that comprise the anatomical system.

terms.label: conditionsOfAccess
terms.comment: Conditions that affect the availability of, or method(s) of access to, an item. Typically used for real world items such as an [[ArchiveComponent]] held by an [[ArchiveOrganization]]. This property is not suitable for use as a general Web access control mechanism. It is expressed only in natural language.\n\nFor example "Available by appointment from the Reading Room" or "Accessible only from logged-in accounts ".

terms.label: confirmationNumber
terms.comment: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

terms.label: connectedTo
terms.comment: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

terms.label: constraintProperty
terms.comment: Indicates a property used as a constraint. For example, in the definition of a [[StatisticalVariable]]. The value is a property, either from within Schema.org or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

terms.label: consumerNotice
terms.comment: A consumer notice, such as a safety warning or mandatory information, related to the product.

terms.label: contactOption
terms.comment: An option available on this contact point (e.g. a toll-free number or support for hearing-impaired callers).

terms.label: contactPoint
terms.comment: A contact point for a person or organization.

terms.label: contactPoints
terms.comment: A contact point for a person or organization.

terms.label: contactType
terms.comment: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.

terms.label: contactlessPayment
terms.comment: A secure method for consumers to purchase products or services via debit, credit or smartcards by using RFID or NFC technology.

terms.label: containedIn
terms.comment: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

terms.label: containedInPlace
terms.comment: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

terms.label: containsPlace
terms.comment: The basic containment relation between a place and another that it contains.

terms.label: containsSeason
terms.comment: A season that is part of the media series.

terms.label: contentLocation
terms.comment: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

terms.label: contentRating
terms.comment: Official rating of a piece of content—for example, 'MPAA PG-13'.

terms.label: contentReferenceTime
terms.comment: The specific time described by a creative work, for works (e.g. articles, video objects etc.) that emphasise a particular moment within an Event.

terms.label: contentSize
terms.comment: File size in (mega/kilo)bytes.

terms.label: contentType
terms.comment: The supported content type(s) for an EntryPoint response.

terms.label: contentUrl
terms.comment: Actual bytes of the media object, for example the image file or video file.

terms.label: contraindication
terms.comment: A contraindication for this therapy.

terms.label: contributor
terms.comment: A secondary contributor to the CreativeWork or Event.

terms.label: cookTime
terms.comment: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

terms.label: cookingMethod
terms.comment: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...

terms.label: copyrightHolder
terms.comment: The party holding the legal copyright to the CreativeWork.

terms.label: copyrightNotice
terms.comment: Text of a notice appropriate for describing the copyright aspects of this Creative Work, ideally indicating the owner of the copyright for the Work.

terms.label: copyrightYear
terms.comment: The year during which the claimed copyright for the CreativeWork was first asserted.

terms.label: correction
terms.comment: Indicates a correction to a [[CreativeWork]], either via a [[CorrectionComment]], textually or in another document.

terms.label: correctionsPolicy
terms.comment: For an [[Organization]] (e.g. [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement describing (in news media, the newsroom’s) disclosure and correction policy for errors.

terms.label: costCategory
terms.comment: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

terms.label: costCurrency
terms.comment: The currency (in 3-letter) of the drug cost. See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217.

terms.label: costOrigin
terms.comment: Additional details to capture the origin of the cost data. For example, 'Medicare Part B'.

terms.label: costPerUnit
terms.comment: The cost per unit of the drug.

terms.label: countriesNotSupported
terms.comment: Countries for which the application is not supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

terms.label: countriesSupported
terms.comment: Countries for which the application is supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

terms.label: countryOfAssembly
terms.comment: The place where the product was assembled.

terms.label: countryOfLastProcessing
terms.comment: The place where the item (typically [[Product]]) was last processed and tested before importation.

terms.label: countryOfOrigin
terms.comment: The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative works such as movie and TV content. In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of [[CreativeWork]] it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as [[contentLocation]] and [[locationCreated]] may be more applicable. In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. …

terms.label: course
terms.comment: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

terms.label: courseCode
terms.comment: The identifier for the [[Course]] used by the course [[provider]] (e.g. CS101 or 6.001).

terms.label: courseMode
terms.comment: The medium or means of delivery of the course instance or the mode of study, either as a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or as a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous).

terms.label: coursePrerequisites
terms.comment: Requirements for taking the Course. May be completion of another [[Course]] or a textual description like "permission of instructor". Requirements may be a pre-requisite competency, referenced using [[AlignmentObject]].

terms.label: courseSchedule
terms.comment: Represents the length and pace of a course, expressed as a [[Schedule]].

terms.label: courseWorkload
terms.comment: The amount of work expected of students taking the course, often provided as a figure per week or per month, and may be broken down by type. For example, "2 hours of lectures, 1 hour of lab work and 3 hours of independent study per week".

terms.label: coverageEndTime
terms.comment: The time when the live blog will stop covering the Event. Note that coverage may continue after the Event concludes.

terms.label: coverageStartTime
terms.comment: The time when the live blog will begin covering the Event. Note that coverage may begin before the Event's start time. The LiveBlogPosting may also be created before coverage begins.

terms.label: creativeWorkStatus
terms.comment: The status of a creative work in terms of its stage in a lifecycle. Example terms include Incomplete, Draft, Published, Obsolete. Some organizations define a set of terms for the stages of their publication lifecycle.

terms.label: creator
terms.comment: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

terms.label: credentialCategory
terms.comment: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

terms.label: creditText
terms.comment: Text that can be used to credit person(s) and/or organization(s) associated with a published Creative Work.

terms.label: creditedTo
terms.comment: The group the release is credited to if different than the byArtist. For example, Red and Blue is credited to "Stefani Germanotta Band", but by Lady Gaga.

terms.label: cssSelector
terms.comment: A CSS selector, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

terms.label: currenciesAccepted
terms.comment: The currency accepted.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

terms.label: currency
terms.comment: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

terms.label: currentExchangeRate
terms.comment: The current price of a currency.

terms.label: customer
terms.comment: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

terms.label: customerRemorseReturnFees
terms.comment: The type of return fees if the product is returned due to customer remorse.

terms.label: customerRemorseReturnLabelSource
terms.comment: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned due to customer remorse.

terms.label: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
terms.comment: The amount of shipping costs if a product is returned due to customer remorse. Applicable when property [[customerRemorseReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

terms.label: cutoffTime
terms.comment: Order cutoff time allows merchants to describe the time after which they will no longer process orders received on that day. For orders processed after cutoff time, one day gets added to the delivery time estimate. This property is expected to be most typically used via the [[ShippingRateSettings]] publication pattern. The time is indicated using the ISO-8601 Time format, e.g. "23:30:00-05:00" would represent 6:30 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) which is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time…

terms.label: cvdCollectionDate
terms.comment: collectiondate - Date for which patient counts are reported.

terms.label: cvdFacilityCounty
terms.comment: Name of the County of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityId]] to identify the facility. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

terms.label: cvdFacilityId
terms.comment: Identifier of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityCounty]] to indicate the county. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

terms.label: cvdNumBeds
terms.comment: numbeds - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BEDS: Inpatient beds, including all staffed, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients.

terms.label: cvdNumBedsOcc
terms.comment: numbedsocc - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient beds that are occupied.

terms.label: cvdNumC19Died
terms.comment: numc19died - DEATHS: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who died in the hospital, ED, or any overflow location.

terms.label: cvdNumC19HOPats
terms.comment: numc19hopats - HOSPITAL ONSET: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location with onset of suspected or confirmed COVID-19 14 or more days after hospitalization.

terms.label: cvdNumC19HospPats
terms.comment: numc19hosppats - HOSPITALIZED: Patients currently hospitalized in an inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19.

terms.label: cvdNumC19MechVentPats
terms.comment: numc19mechventpats - HOSPITALIZED and VENTILATED: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19 and are on a mechanical ventilator.

terms.label: cvdNumC19OFMechVentPats
terms.comment: numc19ofmechventpats - ED/OVERFLOW and VENTILATED: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed and on a mechanical ventilator.

terms.label: cvdNumC19OverflowPats
terms.comment: numc19overflowpats - ED/OVERFLOW: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed.

terms.label: cvdNumICUBeds
terms.comment: numicubeds - ICU BEDS: Total number of staffed inpatient intensive care unit (ICU) beds.

terms.label: cvdNumICUBedsOcc
terms.comment: numicubedsocc - ICU BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient ICU beds that are occupied.

terms.label: cvdNumTotBeds
terms.comment: numtotbeds - ALL HOSPITAL BEDS: Total number of all inpatient and outpatient beds, including all staffed, ICU, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients or outpatients.

terms.label: cvdNumVent
terms.comment: numvent - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS: Total number of ventilators available.

terms.label: cvdNumVentUse
terms.comment: numventuse - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS IN USE: Total number of ventilators in use.

terms.label: data
terms.comment: Data associated with the event, like for instance a log message.

terms.label: dataFeedElement
terms.comment: An item within a data feed. Data feeds may have many elements.

terms.label: dataset
terms.comment: A dataset contained in this catalog.

terms.label: datasetTimeInterval
terms.comment: The range of temporal applicability of a dataset, e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 (in ISO 8601 time interval format).

terms.label: dateCreated
terms.comment: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.

terms.label: dateDeleted
terms.comment: The datetime the item was removed from the DataFeed.

terms.label: dateIssued
terms.comment: The date the ticket was issued.

terms.label: dateModified
terms.comment: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

terms.label: datePosted
terms.comment: Publication date of an online listing.

terms.label: datePublished
terms.comment: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

terms.label: dateRead
terms.comment: The date/time at which the message has been read by the recipient if a single recipient exists.

terms.label: dateReceived
terms.comment: The date/time the message was received if a single recipient exists.

terms.label: dateSent
terms.comment: The date/time at which the message was sent.

terms.label: dateVehicleFirstRegistered
terms.comment: The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

terms.label: dateline
terms.comment: A [dateline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dateline) is a brief piece of text included in news articles that describes where and when the story was written or filed though the date is often omitted. Sometimes only a placename is provided. Structured representations of dateline-related information can also be expressed more explicitly using [[locationCreated]] (which represents where a work was created, e.g. where a news report was written). For location depicted or described in the content, use…

terms.label: dayOfWeek
terms.comment: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid.

terms.label: deathDate
terms.comment: Date of death.

terms.label: deathPlace
terms.comment: The place where the person died.

terms.label: defaultValue
terms.comment: The default value of the input. For properties that expect a literal, the default is a literal value, for properties that expect an object, it's an ID reference to one of the current values.

terms.label: deliveryAddress
terms.comment: Destination address.

terms.label: deliveryLeadTime
terms.comment: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

terms.label: deliveryMethod
terms.comment: A sub property of instrument. The method of delivery.

terms.label: deliveryStatus
terms.comment: New entry added as the package passes through each leg of its journey (from shipment to final delivery).

terms.label: deliveryTime
terms.comment: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.

terms.label: department
terms.comment: A relationship between an organization and a department of that organization, also described as an organization (allowing different urls, logos, opening hours). For example: a store with a pharmacy, or a bakery with a cafe.

terms.label: departureAirport
terms.comment: The airport where the flight originates.

terms.label: departureBoatTerminal
terms.comment: The terminal or port from which the boat departs.

terms.label: departureBusStop
terms.comment: The stop or station from which the bus departs.

terms.label: departureGate
terms.comment: Identifier of the flight's departure gate.

terms.label: departurePlatform
terms.comment: The platform from which the train departs.

terms.label: departureStation
terms.comment: The station from which the train departs.

terms.label: departureTerminal
terms.comment: Identifier of the flight's departure terminal.

terms.label: departureTime
terms.comment: The expected departure time.

terms.label: dependencies
terms.comment: Prerequisites needed to fulfill steps in article.

terms.label: depth
terms.comment: The depth of the item.

terms.label: description
terms.comment: A description of the item.

terms.label: device
terms.comment: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

terms.label: diagnosis
terms.comment: One or more alternative conditions considered in the differential diagnosis process as output of a diagnosis process.

terms.label: diagram
terms.comment: An image containing a diagram that illustrates the structure and/or its component substructures and/or connections with other structures.

terms.label: diet
terms.comment: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

terms.label: dietFeatures
terms.comment: Nutritional information specific to the dietary plan. May include dietary recommendations on what foods to avoid, what foods to consume, and specific alterations/deviations from the USDA or other regulatory body's approved dietary guidelines.

terms.label: differentialDiagnosis
terms.comment: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.

terms.label: digitalSourceType
terms.comment: Indicates an IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration code indicating the nature of the digital source(s) for some [[CreativeWork]].

terms.label: directApply
terms.comment: Indicates whether an [[url]] that is associated with a [[JobPosting]] enables direct application for the job, via the posting website. A job posting is considered to have directApply of [[True]] if an application process for the specified job can be directly initiated via the url(s) given (noting that e.g. multiple internet domains might nevertheless be involved at an implementation level). A value of [[False]] is appropriate if there is no clear path to applying directly online for the specifi…

terms.label: director
terms.comment: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

terms.label: directors
terms.comment: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video games etc. content. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

terms.label: disambiguatingDescription
terms.comment: A sub property of description. A short description of the item used to disambiguate from other, similar items. Information from other properties (in particular, name) may be necessary for the description to be useful for disambiguation.

terms.label: discount
terms.comment: Any discount applied (to an Order).

terms.label: discountCode
terms.comment: Code used to redeem a discount.

terms.label: discountCurrency
terms.comment: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

terms.label: discusses
terms.comment: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.

terms.label: discussionUrl
terms.comment: A link to the page containing the comments of the CreativeWork.

terms.label: diseasePreventionInfo
terms.comment: Information about disease prevention.

terms.label: diseaseSpreadStatistics
terms.comment: Statistical information about the spread of a disease, either as [[WebContent]], or described directly as a [[Dataset]], or the specific [[Observation]]s in the dataset. When a [[WebContent]] URL is provided, the page indicated might also contain more such markup.

terms.label: displayLocation
terms.comment: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

terms.label: dissolutionDate
terms.comment: The date that this organization was dissolved.

terms.label: distance
terms.comment: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

terms.label: distinguishingSign
terms.comment: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.

terms.label: distribution
terms.comment: A downloadable form of this dataset, at a specific location, in a specific format. This property can be repeated if different variations are available. There is no expectation that different downloadable distributions must contain exactly equivalent information (see also [DCAT](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution) on this point). Different distributions might include or exclude different subsets of the entire dataset, for example.

terms.label: diversityPolicy
terms.comment: Statement on diversity policy by an [[Organization]] e.g. a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]. For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement describing the newsroom’s diversity policy on both staffing and sources, typically providing staffing data.

terms.label: diversityStaffingReport
terms.comment: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a report on staffing diversity issues. In a news context this might be for example ASNE or RTDNA (US) reports, or self-reported.

terms.label: documentation
terms.comment: Further documentation describing the Web API in more detail.

terms.label: doesNotShip
terms.comment: Indicates when shipping to a particular [[shippingDestination]] is not available.

terms.label: domainIncludes
terms.comment: Relates a property to a class that is (one of) the type(s) the property is expected to be used on.

terms.label: domiciledMortgage
terms.comment: Whether borrower is a resident of the jurisdiction where the property is located.

terms.label: doorTime
terms.comment: The time admission will commence.

terms.label: dosageForm
terms.comment: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available, e.g. 'tablet', 'suspension', 'injection'.

terms.label: doseSchedule
terms.comment: A dosing schedule for the drug for a given population, either observed, recommended, or maximum dose based on the type used.

terms.label: doseUnit
terms.comment: The unit of the dose, e.g. 'mg'.

terms.label: doseValue
terms.comment: The value of the dose, e.g. 500.

terms.label: downPayment
terms.comment: a type of payment made in cash during the onset of the purchase of an expensive good/service. The payment typically represents only a percentage of the full purchase price.

terms.label: downloadUrl
terms.comment: If the file can be downloaded, URL to download the binary.

terms.label: downvoteCount
terms.comment: The number of downvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

terms.label: drainsTo
terms.comment: The vasculature that the vein drains into.

terms.label: driveWheelConfiguration
terms.comment: The drive wheel configuration, i.e. which roadwheels will receive torque from the vehicle's engine via the drivetrain.

terms.label: dropoffLocation
terms.comment: Where a rental car can be dropped off.

terms.label: dropoffTime
terms.comment: When a rental car can be dropped off.

terms.label: drug
terms.comment: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.

terms.label: drugClass
terms.comment: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).

terms.label: drugUnit
terms.comment: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.

terms.label: duns
terms.comment: The Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for identifying an organization or business person.

terms.label: duplicateTherapy
terms.comment: A therapy that duplicates or overlaps this one.

terms.label: duration
terms.comment: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

terms.label: durationOfWarranty
terms.comment: The duration of the warranty promise. Common unitCode values are ANN for year, MON for months, or DAY for days.

terms.label: duringMedia
terms.comment: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

terms.label: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
terms.comment: The amount to be paid as a penalty in the event of early payment of the loan.

terms.label: editEIDR
terms.comment: An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing a specific edit / edition for a work of film or television. For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" whose [[titleEIDR]] is "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J" has several edits, e.g. "10.5240/1F2A-E1C5-680A-14C6-E76B-I" and "10.5240/8A35-3BEE-6497-5D12-9E4F-3". Since schema.org types like [[Movie]] and [[TVEpisode]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possib…

terms.label: editor
terms.comment: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

terms.label: eduQuestionType
terms.comment: For questions that are part of learning resources (e.g. Quiz), eduQuestionType indicates the format of question being given. Example: "Multiple choice", "Open ended", "Flashcard".

terms.label: educationRequirements
terms.comment: Educational background needed for the position or Occupation.

terms.label: educationalAlignment
terms.comment: An alignment to an established educational framework. This property should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

terms.label: educationalCredentialAwarded
terms.comment: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other educational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

terms.label: educationalFramework
terms.comment: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.

terms.label: educationalLevel
terms.comment: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context. Examples of educational levels include 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced', and formal sets of level indicators.

terms.label: educationalProgramMode
terms.comment: Similar to courseMode, the medium or means of delivery of the program as a whole. The value may either be a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous ).

terms.label: educationalRole
terms.comment: An educationalRole of an EducationalAudience.

terms.label: educationalUse
terms.comment: The purpose of a work in the context of education; for example, 'assignment', 'group work'.

terms.label: elevation
terms.comment: The elevation of a location ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNIT\_OF\_MEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone should be assumed to be a value in meters.

terms.label: eligibilityToWorkRequirement
terms.comment: The legal requirements such as citizenship, visa and other documentation required for an applicant to this job.

terms.label: eligibleCustomerType
terms.comment: The type(s) of customers for which the given offer is valid.

terms.label: eligibleDuration
terms.comment: The duration for which the given offer is valid.

terms.label: eligibleQuantity
terms.comment: The interval and unit of measurement of ordering quantities for which the offer or price specification is valid. This allows e.g. specifying that a certain freight charge is valid only for a certain quantity.

terms.label: eligibleRegion
terms.comment: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

terms.label: eligibleTransactionVolume
terms.comment: The transaction volume, in a monetary unit, for which the offer or price specification is valid, e.g. for indicating a minimal purchasing volume, to express free shipping above a certain order volume, or to limit the acceptance of credit cards to purchases to a certain minimal amount.

terms.label: eligibleWithSupplier
terms.comment: The supplier of the incentivized item/service for which the incentive is valid for such as a utility company, merchant, or contractor.

terms.label: email
terms.comment: Email address.

terms.label: embedUrl
terms.comment: A URL pointing to a player for a specific video. In general, this is the information in the ```src``` element of an ```embed``` tag and should not be the same as the content of the ```loc``` tag.

terms.label: embeddedTextCaption
terms.comment: Represents textual captioning from a [[MediaObject]], e.g. text of a 'meme'.

terms.label: emissionsCO2
terms.comment: The CO2 emissions in g/km. When used in combination with a QuantitativeValue, put "g/km" into the unitText property of that value, since there is no UN/CEFACT Common Code for "g/km".

terms.label: employee
terms.comment: Someone working for this organization.

terms.label: employees
terms.comment: People working for this organization.

terms.label: employerOverview
terms.comment: A description of the employer, career opportunities and work environment for this position.

terms.label: employmentType
terms.comment: Type of employment (e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, seasonal, internship).

terms.label: employmentUnit
terms.comment: Indicates the department, unit and/or facility where the employee reports and/or in which the job is to be performed.

terms.label: encodesBioChemEntity
terms.comment: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

terms.label: encodesCreativeWork
terms.comment: The CreativeWork encoded by this media object.

terms.label: encoding
terms.comment: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for associatedMedia.

terms.label: encodingFormat
terms.comment: Media type typically expressed using a MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) and [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types)), e.g. application/zip for a SoftwareApplication binary, audio/mpeg for .mp3 etc. In cases where a [[CreativeWork]] has several media type representations, [[encoding]] can be used to indicate each [[MediaObject]] alongside particular [[encodingFormat]] information. Unre…

terms.label: encodingType
terms.comment: The supported encoding type(s) for an EntryPoint request.

terms.label: encodings
terms.comment: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork.

terms.label: endDate
terms.comment: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

terms.label: endOffset
terms.comment: The end time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

terms.label: endTime
terms.comment: The endTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to end. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from January to *December*. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the end of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified …

terms.label: endorsee
terms.comment: A sub property of participant. The person/organization being supported.

terms.label: endorsers
terms.comment: People or organizations that endorse the plan.

terms.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
terms.comment: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

terms.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
terms.comment: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

terms.label: engineDisplacement
terms.comment:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: enginePower
terms.comment:
The power of the vehicle's engine. Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference…

terms.label: engineType
terms.comment: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

terms.label: entertainmentBusiness
terms.comment: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

terms.label: epidemiology
terms.comment: The characteristics of associated patients, such as age, gender, race etc.

terms.label: episode
terms.comment: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

terms.label: episodeNumber
terms.comment: Position of the episode within an ordered group of episodes.

terms.label: episodes
terms.comment: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

terms.label: equal
terms.comment: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

terms.label: error
terms.comment: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

terms.label: errorCode
terms.comment: Application or platform dependant error code.

terms.label: estimatedCost
