terms.comment: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.

terms.label: validFrom
terms.comment: The date when the item becomes valid.

terms.label: validIn
terms.comment: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].

terms.label: validThrough
terms.comment: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.

terms.label: validUntil
terms.comment: The date when the item is no longer valid.

terms.label: value
terms.comment:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'StructuredValue' or 'QualitativeValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indic…

terms.label: valueAddedTaxIncluded
terms.comment: Specifies whether the applicable value-added tax (VAT) is included in the price specification or not.

terms.label: valueGroup
terms.comment: A header or section name for grouping related property values.

terms.label: valueMaxLength
terms.comment: Specifies the allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

terms.label: valueMinLength
terms.comment: Specifies the minimum allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

terms.label: valueName
terms.comment: Indicates the name of the PropertyValueSpecification to be used in URL templates and form encoding in a manner analogous to HTML's input@name.

terms.label: valuePattern
terms.comment: Specifies a regular expression for testing literal values according to the HTML spec.

terms.label: valueReference
terms.comment: A secondary value that provides additional information on the original value, e.g. a reference temperature or a type of measurement.

terms.label: valueRequired
terms.comment: Whether the property must be filled in to complete the action. Default is false.

terms.label: variableMeasured
terms.comment: The variableMeasured property can indicate (repeated as necessary) the variables that are measured in some dataset, either described as text or as pairs of identifier and description using PropertyValue, or more explicitly as a [[StatisticalVariable]].

terms.label: variantCover
terms.comment: A description of the variant cover for the issue, if the issue is a variant printing. For example, "Bryan Hitch Variant Cover" or "2nd Printing Variant".

terms.label: variesBy
terms.comment: Indicates the property or properties by which the variants in a [[ProductGroup]] vary, e.g. their size, color etc. Schema.org properties can be referenced by their short name e.g. "color"; terms defined elsewhere can be referenced with their URIs. Variant properties can be provided using [[PropertyValue]] instead of plain [[Text]], to allow specification of the values available for a variant property.

terms.label: vatID
terms.comment: The value-added Tax ID of the organization or person with national prefix (for example IT123456789). Can also be described as [[iso6523Code]] with proper prefix.

terms.label: vehicleConfiguration
terms.comment: A short text indicating the configuration of the vehicle, e.g. '5dr hatchback ST 2.5 MT 225 hp' or 'limited edition'.

terms.label: vehicleEngine
terms.comment: Information about the engine or engines of the vehicle.

terms.label: vehicleIdentificationNumber
terms.comment: The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is a unique serial number used by the automotive industry to identify individual motor vehicles.

terms.label: vehicleInteriorColor
terms.comment: The color or color combination of the interior of the vehicle.

terms.label: vehicleInteriorType
terms.comment: The type or material of the interior of the vehicle (e.g. synthetic fabric, leather, wood, etc.). While most interior types are characterized by the material used, an interior type can also be based on vehicle usage or target audience.

terms.label: vehicleModelDate
terms.comment: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

terms.label: vehicleSeatingCapacity
terms.comment: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

terms.label: vehicleSpecialUsage
terms.comment: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

terms.label: vehicleTransmission
terms.comment: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

terms.label: vendor
terms.comment: 'vendor' is an earlier term for 'seller'.

terms.label: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
terms.comment: Disclosure about verification and fact-checking processes for a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other fact-checking [[Organization]].

terms.label: version
terms.comment: The version of the CreativeWork embodied by a specified resource.

terms.label: video
terms.comment: An embedded video object.

terms.label: videoFormat
terms.comment: The type of screening or video broadcast used (e.g. IMAX, 3D, SD, HD, etc.).

terms.label: videoFrameSize
terms.comment: The frame size of the video.

terms.label: videoQuality
terms.comment: The quality of the video.

terms.label: volumeNumber
terms.comment: Identifies the volume of publication or multi-part work; for example, "iii" or "2".

terms.label: warning
terms.comment: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).

terms.label: warranty
terms.comment: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

terms.label: warrantyPromise
terms.comment: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

terms.label: warrantyScope
terms.comment: The scope of the warranty promise.

terms.label: webCheckinTime
terms.comment: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.

terms.label: webFeed
terms.comment: The URL for a feed, e.g. associated with a podcast series, blog, or series of date-stamped updates. This is usually RSS or Atom.

terms.label: weight
terms.comment: The weight of the product or person.

terms.label: weightPercentage
terms.comment: Value representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price. Example: 0.10 and a shipping weight of 15kg would add $1.5 to the order price, where the $ is the currency of the order.

terms.label: weightTotal
terms.comment:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

terms.label: wheelbase
terms.comment: The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.\n\nTypical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet.

terms.label: width
terms.comment: The width of the item.

terms.label: winner
terms.comment: A sub property of participant. The winner of the action.

terms.label: wordCount
terms.comment: The number of words in the text of the CreativeWork such as an Article, Book, etc.

terms.label: workExample
terms.comment: Example/instance/realization/derivation of the concept of this creative work. E.g. the paperback edition, first edition, or e-book.

terms.label: workFeatured
terms.comment: A work featured in some event, e.g. exhibited in an ExhibitionEvent. Specific subproperties are available for workPerformed (e.g. a play), or a workPresented (a Movie at a ScreeningEvent).

terms.label: workHours
terms.comment: The typical working hours for this job (e.g. 1st shift, night shift, 8am-5pm).

terms.label: workLocation
terms.comment: A contact location for a person's place of work.

terms.label: workPerformed
terms.comment: A work performed in some event, for example a play performed in a TheaterEvent.

terms.label: workPresented
terms.comment: The movie presented during this event.

terms.label: workTranslation
terms.comment: A work that is a translation of the content of this work. E.g. 西遊記 has an English workTranslation “Journey to the West”, a German workTranslation “Monkeys Pilgerfahrt” and a Vietnamese translation Tây du ký bình khảo.

terms.label: workload
terms.comment: Quantitative measure of the physiologic output of the exercise; also referred to as energy expenditure.

terms.label: worksFor
terms.comment: Organizations that the person works for.

terms.label: worstRating
terms.comment: The lowest value allowed in this rating system.

terms.label: xpath
terms.comment: An XPath, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

terms.label: yearBuilt
terms.comment: The year an [[Accommodation]] was constructed. This corresponds to the [YearBuilt field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/YearBuilt+Field).

terms.label: yearlyRevenue
terms.comment: The size of the business in annual revenue.

terms.label: yearsInOperation
terms.comment: The age of the business.

terms.label: yield
terms.comment: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.
